verses.17:14: When you come into the land that the LORD your God is giving to you, and take possession of it and settle in it, and say, "Let me set a king over myself, like all the nations surrounding me,"
verses.17:15: you shall certainly set over yourself a king whom the LORD your God will choose. From the midst of your brothers you shall set a king over yourself; you may not place over yourself a foreign man, one who is not your brother.
verses.17:16: Only, he shall not multiply horses for himself, nor make the people return to Egypt in order to multiply horses, for the LORD has told you, "You shall not return along this way anymore."
verses.17:17: And he shall not multiply wives for himself, so that his heart does not turn aside, nor shall he greatly multiply silver and gold for himself.
verses.17:18: And when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, he shall write for himself a copy of this law on a scroll from before the Levitical priests.
verses.17:19: It shall remain with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, keeping all the words of this law and these statutes to carry them out,
verses.17:20: so that his heart may not rise above his brothers and he may not turn aside from the commandment to the right or to the left, in order that he may lengthen his days over his kingdom, he and his sons, in the midst of Israel.
verses.18:1: The Levitical priests, the entire tribe of Levi, shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel; they shall eat the fire offerings of the LORD and His inheritance.
verses.18:2: And he shall have no inheritance in the midst of his brothers; the LORD Himself is his inheritance, as He spoke to him.
verses.18:3: And this shall be the rightful due of the priests from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether ox or sheep: one shall give to the priest the foreleg, the two cheeks, and the stomach.
verses.18:4: The firstfruits of your grain, your new wine, and your fresh oil, and the first of the shearing of your flock, you shall give to him.
verses.18:5: For the LORD your God has chosen him from all your tribes to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, he and his sons always.
verses.18:6: And if a Levite comes from any one of your gates out of all Israel where he sojourns, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place that the LORD will choose,
verses.18:7: then he may minister in the name of the LORD his God, just like all his brothers the Levites who stand there before the LORD.
verses.18:8: They shall eat portion for portion, apart from his sales of ancestral property.
verses.18:9: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving to you, you shall not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations.
verses.18:10: No one shall be found among you who causes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, a practitioner of divination, a soothsayer, an omen reader, or a sorcerer,
verses.18:11: or a caster of spells, or one who consults a medium or a spiritist, or one who inquires of the dead.
verses.18:12: Because everyone who does these things is an abomination to the LORD, and on account of these abominations the LORD your God is dispossessing them from before you.
verses.18:13: You shall be blameless with the LORD your God.
verses.18:14: For these nations that you are dispossessing listen to soothsayers and to diviners; but as for you, the LORD your God has not permitted this to you.
verses.18:15: The LORD your God will raise up a prophet for you from your midst, from your brothers, like me; to him you shall listen,
verses.18:16: according to all that you requested from the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, saying, "May I not hear the voice of the LORD my God again, and may I not see this great fire anymore, so that I will not die."
verses.18:17: And the LORD said to me, "They have done well in what they have spoken.
verses.18:18: I will raise up a prophet for them from the midst of their brothers, like you, and I will place My words in his mouth, and he will speak to them everything that I command him.
verses.18:19: And it shall be that the man who does not listen to My words that he speaks in My name—I Myself will demand an accounting from him.
verses.18:20: Yet the prophet who acts presumptuously in speaking a word in My name that I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die."
verses.18:21: And if you say in your heart, "How can we know the word that the LORD has not spoken?"
verses.18:22: When a prophet speaks in the name of the LORD and the word does not happen or come about, that is the word that the LORD has not spoken. In presumption the prophet has spoken it; you shall not dread him.
verses.19:1: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations whose land the LORD your God is giving to you, and you dispossess them and live in their cities and in their houses,
verses.19:2: you are to set apart three cities for yourself within your land, which the LORD your God is giving to you to possess.
verses.19:3: You are to prepare the road for yourself and divide into three parts the territory of your land that the LORD your God is granting you as an inheritance, so that every killer may flee there.
verses.19:4: And this is the case of the killer who may flee there and live: one who strikes his neighbor unintentionally, without having hated him beforehand.
verses.19:5: When someone goes with his neighbor into the forest to chop wood, and his hand swings with the axe to cut down the tree, and the iron slips off the wood and hits his neighbor so that he dies, that person may flee to one of these cities and live.
verses.19:6: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might chase after the killer while his heart is hot, and overtake him because the road is long, and strike him fatally, even though no sentence of death applied to him, since he had not hated him beforehand.
verses.19:7: Therefore I am commanding you, saying, "You are to set apart three cities for yourself."
verses.19:8: And if the LORD your God expands your territory, just as He swore to your fathers, and gives you all the land that He spoke of giving to your fathers,
verses.19:9: provided you keep this entire commandment to carry it out, which I am commanding you today, to love the LORD your God and to walk in His ways at all times, then you are to add three more cities for yourself in addition to these three,
verses.19:10: so that innocent blood will not be shed in the midst of your land, which the LORD your God is giving to you as an inheritance, and bloodguilt will not rest upon you.
verses.19:11: But if a man hates his neighbor and lies in wait for him, and rises up against him and strikes him fatally so that he dies, and he flees to one of these cities,
verses.19:12: then the elders of his city are to send and take him from there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood so that he dies.
verses.19:13: Your eye must not show pity on him, and you must purge the blood of the innocent from Israel, so that it may go well for you.
verses.19:14: You must not move back your neighbor's boundary, which earlier generations marked out, in your inheritance that you will inherit in the land which the LORD your God is giving to you to possess.
verses.19:15: A single witness must not stand against a man for any iniquity or for any sin, regarding any offense he may commit; on the word of two witnesses or on the word of three witnesses a matter shall stand.
verses.19:16: If a malicious witness rises against a man to testify against him of a transgression,
verses.19:17: then the two men who have the dispute are to stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges who will be in those days.
verses.19:18: And the judges must investigate thoroughly; and if indeed the witness is a false witness, having testified falsely against his brother,
verses.19:19: then you are to do to him just as he schemed to do to his brother, and you must purge the evil from your midst.
verses.19:20: And the rest will hear and be afraid, and will not again do anything like this evil thing in your midst.
verses.19:21: And your eye must not show pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
verses.20:1: When you go out to war against your enemies and see horses and chariots, a people more numerous than you, do not be afraid of them, for the LORD your God is with you, the One who brought you up from the land of Egypt.
verses.20:2: And when you draw near to the battle, the priest shall step forward and speak to the people.
verses.20:3: And he shall say to them, "Hear, Israel, you are drawing near today for battle against your enemies. Do not let your heart grow faint; do not be afraid, do not panic, and do not be terrified before them,
verses.20:4: for the LORD your God is the One going with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to deliver you."
verses.20:5: Then the officers shall speak to the people, saying, "Who is the man who has built a new house and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, or else he might die in the battle and another man dedicate it.
verses.20:6: And who is the man who has planted a vineyard and has not put it to ordinary use? Let him go and return to his house, or else he might die in the battle and another man put it to ordinary use.
verses.20:7: And who is the man who has betrothed a woman and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, or else he might die in the battle and another man take her."
verses.20:8: And the officers shall speak further to the people and say, "Who is the man who is fearful and faint of heart? Let him go and return to his house, so that the heart of his brothers will not melt like his own heart."
verses.20:9: And when the officers finish speaking to the people, they are to appoint commanders of armies at the head of the people.
verses.20:10: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, you must call out to it for peace.
verses.20:11: And if it answers you with peace and opens to you, then all the people who are found in it shall become forced labor for you and serve you.
verses.20:12: But if it does not make peace with you, and makes war with you, then you shall besiege it.
verses.20:13: And when the LORD your God gives it into your hand, you are to strike down all its males with the edge of the sword.
verses.20:14: Only the women and the little ones and the livestock and everything that is in the city, all its spoil, you may plunder for yourself; and you may consume the spoil of your enemies, which the LORD your God has given to you.
verses.20:15: Thus you are to do to all the cities that are very far from you, which are not among the cities of these nations.
verses.20:16: Only from the cities of these peoples, which the LORD your God is giving to you as an inheritance, you must not keep alive anything that breathes.
verses.20:17: Rather, you must completely devote them to destruction, the Hittites and the Amorites, the Canaanites and the Perizzites, the Hivites and the Jebusites, just as the LORD your God has commanded you,
verses.20:18: so that they will not teach you to do according to all their detestable practices that they have done for their gods, and you sin against the LORD your God.
verses.20:19: When you besiege a city for many days, fighting against it to capture it, you must not destroy its trees by swinging an axe against them, for you may eat from them, and you must not cut them down. For is the tree of the field a human being, that it should come under siege before you?
verses.20:20: Only trees that you know are not food trees, those you may destroy and cut down, and construct siegeworks against the city that is making war with you until it falls.
verses.21:1: If someone who has been killed is found in the land that the LORD your God is giving to you to possess, fallen in the field, and it is not known who struck him,
verses.21:2: then your elders and your judges shall go out and measure to the cities that are around the one who was killed.
verses.21:3: And for the city that is nearest to the one who was killed, the elders of that city shall take a heifer from the herd that has not been worked, that has not pulled in a yoke.
verses.21:4: And the elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with a perennial stream, which is neither worked nor sown, and break the heifer's neck there in the valley.
verses.21:5: Then the priests, the sons of Levi, shall step forward, for the LORD your God has chosen them to minister to Him and to bless in the name of the LORD, and by their word every dispute and every assault is to be decided.
verses.21:6: And all the elders of that city who are nearest to the one who was killed shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.
verses.21:7: And they shall answer and say, "Our hands have not shed this blood, and our eyes have not seen it.
verses.21:8: Atone for Your people Israel, whom You have redeemed, LORD, and do not place innocent blood in the midst of Your people Israel." Then the blood shall be atoned for on their behalf.
verses.21:9: And you will purge the innocent blood from your midst when you do what is right in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.21:10: When you go out to war against your enemies, and the LORD your God gives them into your hand, and you take captives from them,
verses.21:11: and you see among the captives a woman of beautiful form, and you desire her and would take her for yourself as a wife,
verses.21:12: then you shall bring her inside your house, and she shall shave her head and trim her nails.
verses.21:13: She shall also remove the garment of her captivity from herself, and remain in your house and weep for her father and her mother a full month. After that, you may go in to her and be her husband, and she shall become your wife.
verses.21:14: And if you take no delight in her, then you are to send her away as she chooses; you must certainly not sell her for money. You must not treat her as a slave, because you have humbled her.
verses.21:15: If a man has two wives, one loved and the other hated, and they bear him sons, both the loved one and the hated one, and the firstborn son belongs to the hated one,
verses.21:16: then on the day he bequeaths to his sons what belongs to him, he may not treat the son of the loved one as firstborn ahead of the son of the hated one, who is the firstborn.
verses.21:17: Rather, he must recognize the firstborn, the son of the hated one, by giving him a double portion of all that is found belonging to him, for he is the firstfruits of his vigor; the right of the birthright belongs to him.
verses.21:18: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not listen to the voice of his father or to the voice of his mother, and though they discipline him he will not listen to them,
verses.21:19: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.
verses.21:20: And they shall say to the elders of his city, "This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious; he does not listen to our voice; he is a glutton and a drunkard."
verses.21:21: Then all the men of his city shall stone him with stones so that he dies, and you must purge the evil from your midst; and all Israel will hear and be afraid.
verses.21:22: And if a man has committed a sin carrying a sentence of death and is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,
verses.21:23: his corpse must not remain overnight on the tree; rather, you must certainly bury him on that day, for one who is hanged is a curse of God, so that you do not defile your land that the LORD your God is giving to you as an inheritance.
verses.22:1: You shall not see your brother's ox or his sheep wandering astray and hide yourself from them; you shall surely return them to your brother.
verses.22:2: If your brother is not near you, or you do not know him, you shall gather it inside your house, and it shall be with you until your brother searches for it, and you shall return it to him.
verses.22:3: And so you shall do with his donkey, and so you shall do with his garment, and so you shall do with every lost thing of your brother that is lost from him and that you find; you may not hide yourself.
verses.22:4: You shall not see your brother's donkey or his ox fallen on the road and hide yourself from them; you shall surely lift them up with him.
verses.22:5: A man's attire shall not be on a woman, and a man shall not wear a woman's garment, for everyone who does these things is an abomination to the LORD your God.
verses.22:6: If a bird's nest happens to be before you along the road, in any tree or on the ground, with chicks or eggs, and the mother is sitting on the chicks or on the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young.
verses.22:7: You shall surely send the mother away, and the young you may take for yourself, so that it may go well with you and you may lengthen your days.
verses.22:8: When you build a new house, then you shall make a parapet for your roof, and you shall not place bloodguilt on your house if someone falls from it.
verses.22:9: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, otherwise the full yield—the seed that you sow and the produce of the vineyard—will become consecrated.
verses.22:10: You shall not plow with an ox and with a donkey together.
verses.22:11: You shall not wear mixed fabric, wool and linen together.
verses.22:12: You shall make twisted tassels for yourself on the four corners of your cloak, with which you cover yourself.
verses.22:13: If a man takes a wife, and goes in to her, and hates her,
verses.22:14: and lays baseless charges against her, and brings out a bad name against her, and says, "I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I did not find signs of virginity in her,"
verses.22:15: then the father of the young woman and her mother shall take the signs of the young woman's virginity and bring them out to the elders of the city at the gate.
verses.22:16: And the father of the young woman shall say to the elders, "I gave my daughter to this man as a wife, and he hated her,
verses.22:17: and look, he has laid baseless charges, saying, 'I did not find signs of virginity in your daughter.' Yet these are the signs of my daughter's virginity." And they shall spread out the garment before the elders of the city.
verses.22:18: Then the elders of that city shall take the man and discipline him.
verses.22:19: And they shall fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give it to the father of the young woman, because he has brought out a bad name against a virgin of Israel. And she shall be his wife; he may not send her away all his days.
verses.22:20: But if this matter is true, that signs of virginity were not found for the young woman,
verses.22:21: then they shall bring the young woman out to the entrance of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones so that she dies, because she has done a disgraceful thing in Israel by committing sexual immorality in her father's house. And you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.22:22: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then both of them shall die—the man who lay with the woman, and the woman. And you shall purge the evil from Israel.
verses.22:23: If there is a young woman, a virgin betrothed to a man, and a man finds her in the city and lies with her,
verses.22:24: then you shall bring both of them out to the gate of that city, and stone them with stones so that they die—the young woman because she did not cry out in the city, and the man because he violated the wife of his neighbor. And you shall purge the evil from your midst.
verses.22:25: But if in the field the man finds the betrothed young woman, and the man overpowers her and lies with her, then the man who lay with her, he alone, shall die.
verses.22:26: And to the young woman you shall do nothing; the young woman has no sin deserving death, for just as when a man rises up against his neighbor and murders him, so is this matter.
verses.22:27: For he found her in the field; the betrothed young woman cried out, and there was no one to rescue her.
verses.22:28: If a man finds a young woman, a virgin who has not been betrothed, and takes hold of her and lies with her, and they are found,
verses.22:29: then the man who lay with her shall give fifty shekels of silver to the father of the young woman, and she shall be his wife because he violated her; he may not send her away all his days.
verses.23:1: A man shall not take his father's wife, and he shall not uncover the edge of his father's garment.
verses.23:2: No one wounded by crushing or having his male organ cut off shall enter the assembly of the LORD.
verses.23:3: A person of illicit birth shall not enter the assembly of the LORD; even a tenth generation of his shall not enter the assembly of the LORD.
verses.23:4: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter the assembly of the LORD; even a tenth generation of theirs shall not enter the assembly of the LORD forever,
verses.23:5: because they did not come to meet you with bread and water along the road as you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Aram-naharaim to curse you.
verses.23:6: Yet the LORD your God was unwilling to listen to Balaam; rather, the LORD your God turned the curse for you into a blessing, because the LORD your God loved you.
verses.23:7: You shall not seek their peace or their welfare all your days, forever.
verses.23:8: You shall not loathe an Edomite, for he is your brother; you shall not loathe an Egyptian, for you were a resident alien in his land.
verses.23:9: Children who are born to them—a third generation of theirs—may enter the assembly of the LORD.
verses.23:10: When you go out as a camp against your enemies, you shall guard yourself from every evil thing.
verses.23:11: If there is a man among you who is not clean from an occurrence at night, then he shall go outside the camp; he shall not enter into the midst of the camp.
verses.23:12: And as evening draws near, he shall bathe in water, and when the sun goes down, he may enter into the midst of the camp.
verses.23:13: And you shall have a designated place outside the camp, and there you shall go out.
verses.23:14: And you shall have a spade along with your equipment; and when you sit down outside, you shall dig with it, and turn back and cover your excrement.
verses.23:15: For the LORD your God walks about in the midst of your camp to rescue you and to hand your enemies over before you; so your camp shall be holy, that He may not see any indecent thing among you and turn back from following you.
verses.23:16: You shall not surrender to his master a slave who has escaped to you from his master.
verses.23:17: With you he shall live in your midst, in the place that he chooses in one of your gates, wherever it is good for him; you shall not oppress him.
verses.23:18: There shall not be a female shrine prostitute from among the daughters of Israel, and there shall not be a male shrine prostitute from among the sons of Israel.
verses.23:19: You shall not bring the earnings of a prostitute or the price of a dog into the house of the LORD your God for any vow, for both of them are an abomination to the LORD your God.
verses.23:20: You shall not lend at interest to your brother: interest on money, interest on food, interest on anything that may be lent at interest.
verses.23:21: To a foreigner you may lend at interest, but to your brother you shall not lend at interest, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to in the land that you are entering to possess.
verses.23:22: When you make a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not delay in paying it, for the LORD your God will surely demand it from you, and there will be sin in you.
verses.23:23: And if you refrain from vowing, there will be no sin in you.
verses.23:24: You shall keep and do what goes out from your lips, just as you vowed to the LORD your God as a freewill offering, what you spoke with your mouth.
verses.23:25: When you come into your neighbor's standing grain, you may pluck heads of grain with your hand, but you shall not swing a sickle over your neighbor's standing grain.
verses.23:26: When you come into your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat grapes as you desire, to your fill, but you shall not put any into your container.
verses.24:1: If a man takes a wife and becomes her husband, and it happens that she does not find favor in his eyes because he has found an indecent matter in her, so he writes her a document of divorce, places it in her hand, and sends her away from his house,
verses.24:2: and she departs from his house, goes away, and becomes the wife of another man,
verses.24:3: and if the second man hates her, writes her a document of divorce, places it in her hand, and sends her away from his house, or if the second man who took her to himself as a wife dies,
verses.24:4: then her first husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she has been defiled, for that is an abomination before the LORD. And do not bring guilt of sin on the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
verses.24:5: When a man takes a new wife, he must not go out with the army, nor may any duty be laid upon him. He is to be free for his home for one year and bring joy to his wife whom he has taken.
verses.24:6: No one may take a pair of millstones or an upper millstone as a pledge, because it is a life that he is taking as a pledge.
verses.24:7: If a man is found stealing a person from his brothers among the sons of Israel, and he deals brutally with him and sells him, then that thief must die. You must purge the evil from your midst.
verses.24:8: Guard yourself in an affliction of skin disease, observing very carefully and acting according to everything that the Levitical priests instruct you; just as I commanded them, so be careful to do.
verses.24:9: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam along the way when you came out from Egypt.
verses.24:10: When you make a loan of anything to your neighbor, do not enter his house to collect his pledge.
verses.24:11: Stand outside, and the man to whom you are lending shall bring the pledge outside to you.
verses.24:12: And if he is a poor man, do not lie down with his pledge.
verses.24:13: You must certainly return the pledge to him as the sun sets, so that he may lie down in his cloak and bless you, and for you it will be righteousness before the LORD your God.
verses.24:14: You must not exploit a poor and needy hired laborer, whether one of your brothers or one of your resident aliens who is in your land, within your gates.
verses.24:15: On that very day you must give him his wages, and do not let the sun go down on it, because he is poor and sets his soul on it, so that he does not cry out against you to the LORD and sin be upon you.
verses.24:16: Fathers are not to be put to death on account of children, nor are children to be put to death on account of fathers; every person is to be put to death for his own sin.
verses.24:17: Do not distort the justice due a resident alien or a fatherless child, and do not take a widow's garment as a pledge.
verses.24:18: And remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you from there; that is why I am commanding you to do this thing.
verses.24:19: When you reap your harvest in your field and forget a sheaf in the field, you must not turn back to take it. It shall belong to the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow, so that the LORD your God may bless you in every work of your hands.
verses.24:20: When you beat your olive tree, do not go through the branches again behind you. It shall belong to the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow.
verses.24:21: When you harvest the grapes of your vineyard, do not glean behind you. It shall belong to the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow.
verses.24:22: And remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; that is why I am commanding you to do this thing.
verses.25:1: When a dispute arises between men and they come to court, and the judges pass judgment on them, they must vindicate the innocent and condemn the guilty.
verses.25:2: Then if the guilty man deserves a beating, the judge shall have him lie down and be beaten in his presence, with a number of blows matching his guilt.
verses.25:3: He may give him forty blows, but no more; otherwise, if he goes further and strikes him beyond these with a heavy beating, your brother will be humiliated before your eyes.
verses.25:4: Do not muzzle an ox as it threshes.
verses.25:5: When brothers live together and one of them dies and has no son, the dead man's wife must not marry outside to an unrelated man. Her husband's brother shall go in to her, take her to himself as his wife, and fulfill the duty of a husband's brother toward her.
verses.25:6: And the firstborn whom she bears shall carry on the name of his dead brother, so that his name is not wiped out from Israel.
verses.25:7: And if the man does not want to take his brother's wife, then his brother's wife shall go up to the gate, to the elders, and say, "My husband's brother has refused to raise up a name for his brother in Israel; he is unwilling to fulfill the duty of a husband's brother toward me."
verses.25:8: Then the elders of his city shall summon him and speak with him. If he stands firm and says, "I do not want to take her,"
verses.25:9: then his brother's wife shall approach him before the eyes of the elders, draw his sandal off his foot, and spit in his face; and she shall answer and say, "This is what is to be done to the man who does not build his brother's house."
verses.25:10: And in Israel his name shall be called, "The house of the one whose sandal was drawn off."
verses.25:11: When men fight together, a man and his brother, and the wife of one approaches to rescue her husband from the hand of the one striking him, and she reaches out her hand and grasps his private parts,
verses.25:12: then you must cut off her hand; your eye shall show no pity.
verses.25:13: You must not have unequal stone weights in your pouch, one large and one small.
verses.25:14: You must not have unequal ephah measures in your house, one large and one small.
verses.25:15: You must have a complete and just stone weight, and you must have a complete and just ephah measure, so that your days may be lengthened on the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
verses.25:16: For every person who does these things, every person who commits injustice, is an abomination to the LORD your God.
verses.25:17: Remember what Amalek did to you along the way when you came out from Egypt,
verses.25:18: how he encountered you on the way and cut off from your rear all the feeble ones behind you while you were faint and exhausted, and he did not fear God.
verses.25:19: So when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your enemies on every side, in the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance to possess, you must wipe out the memory of Amalek from beneath the heavens. You must not forget.
verses.26:1: Now when you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you take possession of it and settle in it,
verses.26:2: you must take a portion of the first of all the fruit of the soil that you bring in from your land, which the LORD your God is giving you, place it in a basket, and go to the place that the LORD your God will choose to have His name dwell there.
verses.26:3: You shall go to the priest who will be in those days and say to him, "Today I declare to the LORD your God that I have entered the land that the LORD swore to our fathers to give us."
verses.26:4: The priest shall then take the basket from your hand and set it down in front of the altar of the LORD your God.
verses.26:5: Then you shall answer and say before the LORD your God, "A perishing Aramean was my father; he went down to Egypt and resided there as an alien with few people, and there he became a great, mighty, and numerous nation.
verses.26:6: And the Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and placed harsh labor upon us.
verses.26:7: We cried out to the LORD, the God of our fathers, and the LORD listened to our voice and saw our affliction, our hardship, and our oppression.
verses.26:8: Then the LORD brought us out from Egypt with a strong hand and an extended arm, with great dread, and with signs and wonders.
verses.26:9: He brought us to this place and gave this land to us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.26:10: And now, look, I have brought the first of the fruit of the soil that You have given to me, LORD." Then you must set it down before the LORD your God and bow down before the LORD your God.
verses.26:11: You shall rejoice in all the good that the LORD your God has given you and your household, you together with the Levite and the resident alien who is in your midst.
verses.26:12: When you have finished setting aside the entire tithe of your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, and have given it to the Levite, the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow, so that they may eat within your gates and be satisfied,
verses.26:13: then you shall say before the LORD your God, "I have cleared out the sacred portion from the house, and I have also given it to the Levite, the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow, according to Your whole command that You commanded me. I have not turned aside from Your commands, nor have I forgotten.
verses.26:14: I have not eaten any of it during my mourning, nor have I cleared out any of it while unclean, nor have I given any of it for the dead. I have listened to the voice of the LORD my God; I have acted according to everything that You commanded me.
verses.26:15: Look down from Your holy dwelling place, from the heavens, and bless Your people Israel and the soil that You have given to us, just as You swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey."
verses.26:16: This very day the LORD your God is commanding you to carry out these statutes and judgments; and you must keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.26:17: Today you have affirmed the LORD to be God for you, and that you will walk in His ways, keep His statutes, His commands, and His judgments, and listen to His voice.
verses.26:18: And today the LORD has affirmed you to be a people of treasured possession for Himself, just as He spoke to you, and that you are to keep all His commands,
verses.26:19: and that He will place you high above all the nations that He has made, for praise, for renown, and for splendor, and that you will be a holy people to the LORD your God, just as He has spoken.
verses.27:1: And Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, "Observe the entire commandment that I am commanding you today.
verses.27:2: And it will come about, on the day you cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD your God is giving to you, that you shall erect large stones for yourself and plaster them with lime.
verses.27:3: And you shall write on them all the words of this law when you cross over, so that you may come into the land that the LORD your God is giving to you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, promised you.
verses.27:4: And it will come about, when you cross the Jordan, that you shall erect on Mount Ebal these stones concerning which I am commanding you today, and you shall plaster them with lime.
verses.27:5: And you shall build an altar there to the LORD your God, an altar of stones; you shall not wield iron over them.
verses.27:6: With whole stones you shall build the altar of the LORD your God, and you shall offer up burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.
verses.27:7: And you shall sacrifice peace offerings, eat there, and rejoice in the presence of the LORD your God.
verses.27:8: And you shall write on the stones all the words of this law clearly and thoroughly."
verses.27:9: Then Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, "Keep silent and listen, Israel! On this day you have become a people belonging to the LORD your God.
verses.27:10: So you shall listen to the voice of the LORD your God and carry out His commandments and His statutes that I am commanding you today."
verses.27:11: And Moses commanded the people on that day, saying:
verses.27:12: "These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people when you cross the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.27:13: And these shall stand for the curse on Mount Ebal: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.27:14: Then the Levites shall speak out and say to every man of Israel with a loud voice:
verses.27:15: 'Cursed is the man who makes a carved image or a cast image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of a craftsman, and places it in secret.' And all the people shall respond and say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:16: 'Cursed is the one who treats his father or his mother with contempt.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:17: 'Cursed is the one who shifts his neighbor's boundary.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:18: 'Cursed is the one who leads a blind person astray on the road.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:19: 'Cursed is the one who subverts the justice due a resident alien, a fatherless child, or a widow.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:20: 'Cursed is the one who lies with his father's wife, because he has uncovered the edge of his father's garment.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:21: 'Cursed is the one who lies with any animal.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:22: 'Cursed is the one who lies with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:23: 'Cursed is the one who lies with his mother-in-law.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:24: 'Cursed is the one who strikes down his neighbor in secret.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:25: 'Cursed is the one who takes a bribe to strike down a life of innocent blood.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
verses.27:26: 'Cursed is the one who does not uphold the words of this law by doing them.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'"
verses.28:1: And it will come about that if you truly listen to the voice of the LORD your God, taking care to carry out all His commands that I am commanding you today, the LORD your God will place you highest above all the nations of the earth.
verses.28:2: And all these blessings will come on you and catch up with you, if you listen to the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.28:3: You will be blessed in the city, and you will be blessed in the field.
verses.28:4: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, and the fruit of your soil, and the fruit of your livestock—the offspring of your cattle and the increase of your flock.
verses.28:5: Your basket and your kneading bowl will be blessed.
verses.28:6: You will be blessed in your coming in, and you will be blessed in your going out.
verses.28:7: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck down before you; by one way they will go out against you, and by seven ways they will flee before you.
verses.28:8: The LORD will command the blessing to be with you in your granaries and in every undertaking of your hand, and He will bless you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
verses.28:9: The LORD will establish you for Himself as a holy people, just as He swore to you, if you keep the commands of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.
verses.28:10: And all the peoples of the earth will see that the name of the LORD is called over you, and they will fear you.
verses.28:11: And the LORD will cause you to overflow with prosperity, in the fruit of your womb, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your soil, upon the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.28:12: The LORD will open for you His good treasury, the heavens, to give the rain of your land at its time and to bless every work of your hand; and you will lend to many nations, while you yourself will not borrow.
verses.28:13: And the LORD will set you as the head and not the tail, and you will be only above and will not be below, if you listen to the commands of the LORD your God that I am commanding you today, to keep and to carry out,
verses.28:14: and you do not turn aside from any of the words that I am commanding you today, to the right or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.28:15: But it will come about that if you do not listen to the voice of the LORD your God, taking care to carry out all His commands and His statutes that I am commanding you today, then all these curses will come on you and catch up with you.
verses.28:16: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.
verses.28:17: Your basket and your kneading bowl will be cursed.
verses.28:18: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, and the fruit of your soil, the offspring of your cattle, and the increase of your flock.
verses.28:19: You will be cursed in your coming in, and you will be cursed in your going out.
verses.28:20: The LORD will send against you curse, panic, and rebuke in every undertaking of your hand that you do, until you are destroyed and until you perish swiftly, because of the wickedness of your deeds, in that you have forsaken Me.
verses.28:21: The LORD will cause pestilence to cling to you until He wipes you out from the land that you are entering to possess.
verses.28:22: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever, with inflammation, with scorching heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew, and they will pursue you until you perish.
verses.28:23: And your heavens that are above your head will be bronze, and the earth that is beneath you will be iron.
verses.28:24: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into fine dust and earth; from the heavens it will come down on you until you are destroyed.
verses.28:25: The LORD will cause you to be struck down before your enemies; by one way you will go out against them, and by seven ways you will flee before them; and you will become an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.28:26: And your corpse will become food for all the birds of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth, with no one to scare them away.
verses.28:27: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with hemorrhoids, with scabs, and with the itch, from which you will not be able to be healed.
verses.28:28: The LORD will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with confusion of heart.
verses.28:29: And you will be groping at midday, just as a blind man gropes in thick darkness, and you will not make your ways succeed; and you will be only oppressed and robbed all the time, with no rescuer.
verses.28:30: You will betroth a woman, yet another man will lie with her; you will build a house, yet you will not live in it; you will plant a vineyard, yet you will not enjoy its produce.
verses.28:31: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, yet you will not eat from it; your donkey will be seized from before you and will not return to you; your flock will be given to your enemies, and you will have no rescuer.
verses.28:32: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people, while your eyes watch and pine away for them all day long, and there will be no power in your hand.
verses.28:33: A people whom you have not known will eat the fruit of your soil and all your toil, and you will be only oppressed and crushed all the time.
verses.28:34: And you will go mad from the sight of your eyes that you will see.
verses.28:35: The LORD will strike you with malignant boils on the knees and on the legs, from which you will not be able to be healed, from the sole of your foot even to the top of your head.
verses.28:36: The LORD will lead you and your king whom you appoint over yourself to a nation that you and your fathers have not known, and there you will serve other gods—wood and stone.
verses.28:37: And you will become an object of shock, a proverb, and a taunt among all the peoples where the LORD drives you.
verses.28:38: You will take out much seed to the field, yet you will gather little, because the locust will devour it.
verses.28:39: You will plant vineyards and tend them, yet you will not drink wine nor gather the harvest, because the worm will eat it.
verses.28:40: You will have olive trees in all your territory, yet you will not rub yourself with oil, because your olives will fall off.
verses.28:41: You will father sons and daughters, yet they will not belong to you, because they will go into captivity.
verses.28:42: The cricket will take possession of all your trees and the fruit of your soil.
verses.28:43: The resident alien who is in your midst will ascend above you higher and higher, while you will descend lower and lower.
verses.28:44: He will lend to you, yet you will not lend to him; he will become the head, and you will become the tail.
verses.28:45: And all these curses will come on you and pursue you and catch up with you until you are destroyed, because you did not listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to keep His commands and His statutes that He commanded you.
verses.28:46: And they will be upon you as a sign and a wonder, and upon your seed forever.
verses.28:47: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart for the abundance of everything,
verses.28:48: you will serve your enemies whom the LORD will send against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in the lack of everything; and He will place an iron yoke upon your neck until He destroys you.
verses.28:49: The LORD will raise up a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, just as the eagle swoops, a nation whose language you will not understand,
verses.28:50: a fierce-faced nation that will show no regard for the elderly and will show no pity to the young.
verses.28:51: And it will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your soil until you are destroyed; it will not leave you grain, new wine, or fresh oil, nor the offspring of your cattle or the increase of your flock, until it causes you to perish.
verses.28:52: And it will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trust come down across all your land; and it will besiege you in all your gates across all your land that the LORD your God has given you.
verses.28:53: Then you will eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of your sons and your daughters whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will press hard on you.
verses.28:54: The man among you who is tender and very delicate—his eye will turn begrudging toward his brother, toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the rest of his children whom he leaves remaining,
verses.28:55: so that he will not give to any of them from the flesh of his children that he is eating, because nothing has been left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will press hard on you in all your gates.
verses.28:56: The woman among you who is tender and delicate, who would not attempt to place the sole of her foot on the ground out of delicacy and tenderness—her eye will turn begrudging toward the husband of her bosom, toward her son, and toward her daughter,
verses.28:57: and toward her afterbirth that comes out from between her feet and toward her children whom she bears, because she will eat them in secret in the lack of everything, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will press hard on you in your gates.
verses.28:58: If you do not take care to carry out all the words of this law written in this book, to fear this glorious and fearsome name, the LORD your God,
verses.28:59: then the LORD will make your afflictions and the afflictions of your seed extraordinary—great and enduring afflictions, and severe and enduring sicknesses.
verses.28:60: And He will bring back upon you all the diseases of Egypt that you dreaded, and they will cling to you.
verses.28:61: Even every sickness and every affliction that is not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed.
verses.28:62: And you will be left few in number, whereas you had been like the stars of the heavens in multitude, because you did not listen to the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.28:63: And it will come about that just as the LORD rejoiced over you to do good to you and to multiply you, so the LORD will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you; and you will be uprooted from the land that you are entering to possess.
verses.28:64: And the LORD will scatter you among all the peoples, from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth, and there you will serve other gods that you and your fathers have not known—wood and stone.
verses.28:65: And among those nations you will find no repose, and there will be no place of rest for the sole of your foot; and there the LORD will give you a quaking heart, pining of eyes, and despair of soul.
verses.28:66: And your life will hang in suspense before you; you will feel dread night and day, and you will have no certainty of your life.
verses.28:67: In the morning you will say, "I wish it were evening!" and in the evening you will say, "I wish it were morning!" because of the dread of your heart that you will feel and the sight of your eyes that you will see.
verses.28:68: And the LORD will bring you back to Egypt in ships, by the way of which I told you, "You will not see it again." And there you will put yourselves up for sale to your enemies as male and female slaves, with no buyer.
verses.28:69: These are the words of the covenant that the LORD commanded Moses to make with the sons of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant that He made with them at Horeb.
verses.29:1: Then Moses called to all Israel and said to them, "You yourselves saw everything that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
verses.29:2: the great testings that your eyes saw, those great signs and wonders.
verses.29:3: Yet the LORD has not given you a heart to know, or eyes to see, or ears to hear, until this day.
verses.29:4: And I led you for forty years in the wilderness; your garments did not wear out on you, and your sandal did not wear out on your foot.
verses.29:5: You did not eat bread, nor did you drink wine or intoxicating drink, so that you would know that I am the LORD your God.
verses.29:6: Then you came to this place, and Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out to meet us for battle, and we struck them down.
verses.29:7: And we took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of the Manassites.
verses.29:8: Therefore you shall keep the words of this covenant and do them, so that you may succeed in everything that you do.
verses.29:9: You are standing today, all of you, before the LORD your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, every man of Israel,
verses.29:10: your little ones, your wives, and your resident alien who is in the midst of your camps, from the cutter of your wood to the drawer of your water,
verses.29:11: so that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God and into His oath, which the LORD your God is making with you today,
verses.29:12: in order to establish you today for Himself as a people, and that He may be God to you, just as He spoke to you and just as He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.29:13: And it is not with you alone that I am making this covenant and this oath,
verses.29:14: but with the one who is here with us standing today before the LORD our God, and with the one who is not here with us today—
verses.29:15: for you yourselves know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we passed through the midst of the nations through which you passed,
verses.29:16: and you saw their detestable things and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were with them—
verses.29:17: so that there may not be among you a man or woman, or a clan or tribe, whose heart is turning away today from the LORD our God to go to serve the gods of those nations, so that there may not be among you a root bearing poison and wormwood.
verses.29:18: And it will be, when he hears the words of this sworn curse, that he will bless himself in his heart, saying, 'Peace will be mine, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart'—so as to sweep away the watered with the dry.
verses.29:19: The LORD will not be willing to pardon him; rather, then the anger of the LORD and His jealousy will smoke against that man, and every sworn curse written in this book will lie upon him, and the LORD will wipe out his name from under the heavens.
verses.29:20: And the LORD will set him apart for calamity from all the tribes of Israel, according to all the sworn curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.
verses.29:21: And the coming generation, your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who comes from a distant land will say, when they see the plagues of that land and its sicknesses with which the LORD has made it sick—
verses.29:22: all its land is sulfur and salt, a burned waste; it is not sown, nor does it bring forth growth, nor does any plant come up in it, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in His anger and in His wrath—
verses.29:23: all the nations will say, 'Why has the LORD done so to this land? What is this great burning of anger?'
verses.29:24: And they will say, 'Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them out from the land of Egypt,
verses.29:25: and they went and served other gods and bowed down to them, gods that they did not know and that He had not apportioned to them.
verses.29:26: So the anger of the LORD burned against that land, to bring upon it the entire curse written in this book;
verses.29:27: and the LORD uprooted them from their soil in anger, and in wrath, and in great fury, and hurled them into another land, as it is this day.'
verses.29:28: The hidden things belong to the LORD our God, while the revealed things belong to us and to our children forever, to do all the words of this law."
verses.30:1: "And it will be, when all these things come upon you, the blessing and the curse that I have placed before you, and you call them back to your heart among all the nations to which the LORD your God has banished you,
verses.30:2: and you return to the LORD your God and listen to His voice according to everything that I am commanding you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.30:3: then the LORD your God will restore your fortunes and show compassion to you, and He will again gather you from all the peoples to which the LORD your God has scattered you.
verses.30:4: If your banished ones are at the end of the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there He will take you.
verses.30:5: And the LORD your God will bring you to the land that your fathers possessed, and you will possess it; and He will make you prosper and make you more numerous than your fathers.
verses.30:6: Then the LORD your God will circumcise your heart and the heart of your seed, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, for the sake of your life.
verses.30:7: And the LORD your God will place all these sworn curses upon your enemies and upon those who hate you, who pursued you.
verses.30:8: And you yourself will again listen to the voice of the LORD, and do all His commandments that I am commanding you today.
verses.30:9: Then the LORD your God will make you abound in every work of your hand, in the fruit of your womb, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your soil, for good; for the LORD will again delight over you for good, just as He delighted over your fathers,
verses.30:10: if you listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes that are written in this book of the law, if you return to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.30:11: For this commandment that I am commanding you today is not beyond you, nor is it far away.
verses.30:12: It is not in the heavens, for anyone to say, 'Who will go up for us to the heavens and get it for us, and cause us to hear it, so that we may do it?'
verses.30:13: Nor is it beyond the sea, for anyone to say, 'Who will cross over for us to the other side of the sea and get it for us, and cause us to hear it, so that we may do it?'
verses.30:14: Rather, the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, for you to do it.
verses.30:15: Look, I have placed before you today life and good, and death and evil,
verses.30:16: in that I am commanding you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commandments and His statutes and His ordinances; then you will live and become numerous, and the LORD your God will bless you in the land that you are entering to possess.
verses.30:17: But if your heart turns away and you do not listen, and you are drawn away and bow down to other gods and serve them,
verses.30:18: I announce to you today that you will certainly perish; you will not prolong your days on the land that you are crossing the Jordan to enter and possess.
verses.30:19: I summon the heavens and the earth as witnesses against you today: life and death I have placed before you, the blessing and the curse. Choose life, therefore, so that you may live, you and your seed,
verses.30:20: loving the LORD your God, listening to His voice, and clinging to Him; for He is your life and the length of your days, so that you may live on the land that the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them."
verses.31:1: And Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.
verses.31:2: He said to them, "I am one hundred and twenty years old today; I can no longer go out and come in, and the LORD has said to me, 'You shall not cross over this Jordan.'
verses.31:3: The LORD your God Himself is crossing over before you; He will destroy these nations from before you, and you will dispossess them. Joshua himself is crossing over before you, just as the LORD has spoken.
verses.31:4: And the LORD will do to them just as He did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and to their land, whom He destroyed.
verses.31:5: And the LORD will give them over before you, and you are to do to them according to the entire commandment that I have commanded you.
verses.31:6: Be strong and take courage; do not fear and do not tremble before them, for the LORD your God Himself is the One going with you; He will not let go of you, and He will not abandon you."
verses.31:7: Then Moses called to Joshua and said to him before the eyes of all Israel, "Be strong and take courage, for you will go with this people into the land that the LORD swore to their fathers to give to them, and you will cause them to inherit it.
verses.31:8: And the LORD Himself is the One going before you; He will be with you. He will not let go of you, and He will not abandon you. Do not fear, and do not be dismayed."
verses.31:9: And Moses wrote this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, the bearers of the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.
verses.31:10: Then Moses commanded them, saying, "At the end of every seven years, at the appointed time of the year of release, during the Feast of Booths,
verses.31:11: when all Israel comes to appear in the presence of the LORD your God in the place that He will choose, you are to read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.31:12: Assemble the people—the men, the women, the little ones, and your resident alien who is within your gates—so that they may hear and so that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and take care to do all the words of this law.
verses.31:13: And their children, who have not known, will hear and learn to fear the LORD your God all the days that you live on the land that you are crossing over the Jordan to possess."
verses.31:14: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Look, the days have drawn near for you to die. Call Joshua, and station yourselves in the tent of meeting, so that I may commission him." So Moses and Joshua went and stationed themselves in the tent of meeting.
verses.31:15: Then the LORD appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the doorway of the tent.
verses.31:16: And the LORD said to Moses, "Look, you are about to lie down with your fathers; and this people will rise up and prostitute themselves after the foreign gods of the land into whose midst they are going, and they will abandon Me and break My covenant that I made with them.
verses.31:17: Then My anger will burn against them on that day, and I will abandon them and hide My face from them, and they will be devoured. And many calamities and distresses will overtake them, and they will say on that day, 'Is it not because our God is not in our midst that these calamities have overtaken us?'
verses.31:18: And I will certainly hide My face on that day on account of all the evil that they have done, for they have turned to other gods.
verses.31:19: And now, write down this song for yourselves, and teach it to the sons of Israel; place it in their mouths, in order that this song may be a witness for Me against the sons of Israel.
verses.31:20: For when I bring them into the land flowing with milk and honey that I swore to their fathers, and they eat and are filled and grow fat, they will turn to other gods and serve them, and they will treat Me with contempt and break My covenant.
verses.31:21: And it will come about, when many calamities and distresses overtake them, that this song will testify before them as a witness—for it will not be forgotten from the mouth of their seed—for I know their inclination, which they are forming today, before I bring them into the land of which I swore."
verses.31:22: Then Moses wrote down this song on that day and taught it to the sons of Israel.
verses.31:23: And He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun and said, "Be strong and take courage, for you will bring the sons of Israel into the land that I swore to them, and I Myself will be with you."
verses.31:24: And it happened, when Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book to their completion,
verses.31:25: that Moses commanded the Levites, the bearers of the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,
verses.31:26: "Take this book of the law and place it at the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and it will be there as a witness against you.
verses.31:27: For I myself know your rebellion and your stiff neck; look, while I am still alive with you today, you have been rebellious against the LORD—how much more after my death!
verses.31:28: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officials, so that I may speak these words in their hearing and summon the heavens and the earth to witness against them.
verses.31:29: For I know that after my death you will certainly act corruptly and turn aside from the way that I have commanded you, and calamity will come upon you in the latter days, because you will do what is evil in the eyes of the LORD, so as to provoke Him to anger by the work of your hands."
verses.31:30: Then Moses spoke in the hearing of the entire assembly of Israel the words of this song to their completion.
verses.32:1: Listen attentively, heavens, and I will speak, and let the earth hear the utterances of my mouth.
verses.32:2: May my instruction drip like rain, may my speech flow like dew, like light rain upon fresh grass, and like abundant showers upon green plants.
verses.32:3: For I will call out the name of the LORD; give greatness to our God!
verses.32:4: The Rock—flawless is His work, for all His ways are justice; a God of faithfulness, and there is no wrongdoing; He is righteous and upright.
verses.32:5: They have behaved corruptly toward Him; they are not His children—the blemish is theirs, a crooked and warped generation.
verses.32:6: Is it to the LORD that you repay this, foolish people without wisdom? Is He not your Father who acquired you? He made you and established you.
verses.32:7: Remember the ancient days; discern the years of generation after generation. Ask your father, and he will report it to you; your elders, and they will speak to you.
verses.32:8: When the Most High gave inheritances to the nations, when He separated the sons of Adam, He fixed the borders of the peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel.
verses.32:9: For the share of the LORD is His people; Jacob is the measured lot of His inheritance.
verses.32:10: He found him in a wilderness land, and in a desolate, howling wasteland; He surrounded him, He attended to him, He protected him like the pupil of His eye.
verses.32:11: Like an eagle that rouses its nest and hovers over its fledglings, He spread out His wings, took him, and bore him upon His pinions.
verses.32:12: The LORD by Himself led him, and with Him there was no foreign god.
verses.32:13: He caused him to ride upon the heights of the earth, and he ate the yield of the field; He nursed him with honey from the crag, and oil from the flint rock,
verses.32:14: curds of cattle and milk of the flock, along with the fat of lambs, rams that are offspring of Bashan, and male goats, along with the fat of the kidneys of wheat; and you drank the blood of the grape, foaming wine.
verses.32:15: Then Jeshurun grew fat and kicked—you grew fat, you grew thick, you were gorged—and he abandoned God who made him, and treated with contempt the Rock of his salvation.
verses.32:16: They roused Him to jealousy with alien gods; with abominations they angered Him.
verses.32:17: They sacrificed to demons, which are not God—to gods they did not know, new ones that arrived recently, before whom your fathers did not shudder.
verses.32:18: The Rock who fathered you, you neglected, and you forgot the God who brought you forth.
verses.32:19: The LORD saw it and scorned them, because of the vexation of His sons and His daughters.
verses.32:20: And He said, "I will conceal My face from them; I will see what their outcome will be, for they are a generation of perversity, children with no faithfulness in them.
verses.32:21: They have roused Me to jealousy with what is not a god; they have angered Me with their worthless things. So I Myself will rouse them to jealousy with those who are not a people; with a foolish nation I will anger them.
verses.32:22: For a fire has flared up in My anger, and it blazes all the way to the lowest Sheol; it devours the earth and its produce, and sets ablaze the foundations of the mountains.
verses.32:23: I will pile calamities upon them; My arrows I will exhaust against them.
verses.32:24: They will be drained by famine, devoured by burning fever and bitter pestilence; the teeth of beasts I will let loose against them, along with the venom of creatures crawling in the dust.
verses.32:25: From outside, the sword will bereave, and from within the chambers, terror—both young man and virgin, the nursing infant along with the gray-haired man.
verses.32:26: I said, 'I would cleave them in pieces; I would cause their remembrance to cease from humanity,'
verses.32:27: had I not dreaded the vexation of the enemy, that their foes might misinterpret it, that they might say, 'Our hand has risen high, and it was not the LORD who performed all this.'"
verses.32:28: For they are a nation bereft of counsel, and in them there is no discernment.
verses.32:29: If only they were wise, they would comprehend this; they would discern their outcome!
verses.32:30: How could one pursue a thousand, and two drive ten thousand into flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had handed them over?
verses.32:31: For their rock is not like our Rock, and our enemies themselves are judges.
verses.32:32: For from the vine of Sodom is their vine, and from the terraced fields of Gomorrah; their grapes are grapes of poison, and clusters of bitterness are theirs.
verses.32:33: The venom of serpents is their wine, and the cruel poison of cobras.
verses.32:34: "Is it not stored away with Me, sealed in My storehouses?
verses.32:35: Mine are vengeance and repayment, for the time when their foot totters; for the day of their ruin is near, and the things prepared for them are hastening on."
verses.32:36: For the LORD will render justice for His people, and He will feel compassion for His servants, when He sees that strength has vanished and no one remains, neither restrained nor free.
verses.32:37: Then He will say, "Where are their gods—the rock where they sought refuge,
verses.32:38: who used to eat the fat of their sacrifices and drink the wine of their drink offering? Let them arise and aid you; let them be a shelter over you!
verses.32:39: See now that I, I am He, and there is no god with Me; I Myself put to death and bring to life; I have wounded, and I Myself will heal, and there is no one who rescues from My hand.
verses.32:40: For I raise My hand to heaven and say, 'As I live forever,
verses.32:41: when I sharpen the flash of My sword and My hand grasps justice, I will return vengeance to My foes, and those who hate Me I will repay.
verses.32:42: I will make My arrows drunk on blood, and My sword will devour flesh—from the blood of the killed and the captives, from the unshorn heads of the enemy.'"
verses.32:43: Acclaim His people, nations, for He will avenge the blood of His servants; He will return vengeance to His foes, and will make atonement for His land, His people.
verses.32:44: Then Moses came and spoke all the words of this song within the hearing of the people, he and Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.32:45: And Moses finished speaking all these words to all Israel.
verses.32:46: Then he said to them, "Set your heart on all the words that I am testifying to you today, so that you may command them to your children, to observe and carry out all the words of this law.
verses.32:47: For it is not an empty word for you; rather, it is your life, and through this word you will lengthen your days upon the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess."
verses.32:48: Then the LORD spoke to Moses on that very day, saying,
verses.32:49: "Ascend to this mountain of the Abarim, Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab facing Jericho, and view the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the sons of Israel as a possession.
verses.32:50: And die upon the mountain you are ascending, and be gathered to your kin, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his kin,
verses.32:51: because you acted unfaithfully against Me among the sons of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin—because you did not regard Me as holy among the sons of Israel.
verses.32:52: For from a distance you will see the land, yet you will not enter there—into the land that I am giving to the sons of Israel."
verses.33:1: And this is the blessing by which Moses, the man of God, blessed the sons of Israel before his death.
verses.33:2: And he said, "The LORD came from Sinai and rose from Seir upon them; He blazed forth from Mount Paran and arrived from myriads of holy ones; from His right hand was a fiery law for them.
verses.33:3: Truly, He loves the peoples; all His holy ones are in Your hand; they settled down at Your feet, and each one receives from Your words.
verses.33:4: Moses commanded a law for us, a possession for the congregation of Jacob.
verses.33:5: And He became king in Jeshurun as the heads of the people gathered, the tribes of Israel as one.
verses.33:6: May Reuben live and not die, and may his men not be few."
verses.33:7: And this is for Judah; he said, "Hear Judah's voice, LORD, and bring him to his people. With his own hands he strives for himself, and may You be a help against his foes."
verses.33:8: And concerning Levi he said, "Your Thummim and Your Urim belong to Your faithful man, whom You tested at Massah, with whom You strove at the waters of Meribah;
verses.33:9: who said regarding his father and his mother, 'I have not seen him,' and did not recognize his brothers, and did not know his sons; for they kept Your word and guard Your covenant.
verses.33:10: They shall teach Your judgments to Jacob and Your law to Israel; they shall set incense before Your nostrils and a whole burnt offering on Your altar.
verses.33:11: Bless his strength, LORD, and be pleased with the work of his hands; crush the loins of those who rise against him and of those who hate him, so that they may not rise."
verses.33:12: Concerning Benjamin he said, "The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety beside Him; He shields him all day long, and between his shoulders He dwells."
verses.33:13: And concerning Joseph he said, "Blessed by the LORD is his land, with the choice bounty of the heavens, with dew, and with the deep that lies beneath,
verses.33:14: and with the choice bounty of the yields of the sun, and with the choice bounty thrust forth by the months,
verses.33:15: and with the finest of the ancient mountains, and with the choice bounty of the everlasting hills,
verses.33:16: and with the choice bounty of the earth and its fullness, and the favor of the One who dwelt in the bush. May it come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the crown of the head of the one set apart among his brothers.
verses.33:17: The firstborn of his bull—splendor belongs to him, and the horns of a wild ox are his horns; with them he will gore peoples together, to the ends of the earth. And these are the myriads of Ephraim, and these are the thousands of Manasseh."
verses.33:18: And concerning Zebulun he said, "Rejoice, Zebulun, when you go out, and Issachar, in your tents.
verses.33:19: They will summon peoples to the mountain; there they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw in the abundance of the seas and the hidden treasures buried in the sand."
verses.33:20: And concerning Gad he said, "Blessed is the One who enlarges Gad; he dwells like a lion and tears the arm, indeed the crown of the head.
verses.33:21: And he selected the first portion for himself, for there a commander's allotment was reserved; and he arrived with the heads of the people; he carried out the righteousness of the LORD, and His judgments with Israel."
verses.33:22: And concerning Dan he said, "Dan is a lion cub; he springs forth from Bashan."
verses.33:23: And concerning Naphtali he said, "Naphtali, satisfied with favor and filled with the LORD's blessing, possess the sea and the south."
verses.33:24: And concerning Asher he said, "Blessed above sons is Asher; let him be the favored one of his brothers, and let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.33:25: Iron and bronze shall be your bolts, and according to your days shall your strength be.
verses.33:26: There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides the heavens for your help, and in His majesty, the skies.
verses.33:27: A dwelling place is the ancient God, and beneath are everlasting arms; He expelled the enemy from before you and said, 'Destroy!'
verses.33:28: Thus Israel dwells in safety—the spring of Jacob alone—in a land of grain and new wine; indeed, his heavens drip dew.
verses.33:29: Happy are you, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help and the One who is the sword of your majesty! Your enemies will cringe before you, and upon their high places you will tread."
verses.34:1: And Moses ascended from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the summit of Pisgah that faces Jericho. And the LORD showed him the whole land: Gilead as far as Dan,
verses.34:2: and all of Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and the whole land of Judah as far as the western sea,
verses.34:3: and the Negev, and the Plain—the valley of Jericho, the city of palms—as far as Zoar.
verses.34:4: And the LORD said to him, "This is the land about which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, 'To your seed I will give it.' I have caused you to see it with your own eyes, yet you shall not cross over there."
verses.34:5: And there Moses, the servant of the LORD, died in the land of Moab, at the LORD's command.
verses.34:6: And He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab, across from Beth-peor; yet no one knows his burial site to this day.
verses.34:7: And Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died; his eye had not grown dim, and his vitality had not fled.
verses.34:8: And the sons of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days; then the days of weeping in mourning for Moses were completed.
verses.34:9: And Joshua, the son of Nun, was full of a spirit of wisdom, because Moses had laid his hands upon him; so the sons of Israel heeded him and did just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.34:10: And no prophet like Moses has arisen again in Israel, whom the LORD knew face to face,
verses.34:11: in all the signs and the wonders that the LORD sent him to perform in the land of Egypt, against Pharaoh, and against all his servants, and against his whole land,
verses.34:12: and in all the mighty hand and in all the great awe-inspiring work that Moses performed before the eyes of all Israel.

notes.1:4: The Masoretic Hebrew reads "in Ashtaroth, at Edrei" without a conjunction before "at Edrei," indicating where Og resided and where he was defeated, whereas the Septuagint inserts "and."
notes.1:17: "Show favoritism" renders the Hebrew idiom "recognize faces" (Hiphil of nakar with panim), denoting partiality in legal judgment.
notes.1:35: Following the oath verb in 1:34, the Hebrew particle im ("if") introduces a standard negative oath formula with an omitted self-imprecation, giving the emphatic sense "Not a man... shall see."
notes.1:41: "Considered it a light thing" translates a unique Hiphil form of the root hun (occurring only here in the Hebrew Bible), meaning to regard a task as easy or treat it lightly.
notes.1:46: "For as many days as you stayed" preserves the Hebrew idem per idem idiom (literally "like the days that you stayed"), used to summarize an extended period already known to the listeners.
notes.2:6: The Hebrew uses two distinct Qal verbs here: shavar ("buy grain/food," cf. its Hiphil "sell food" in 2:28) and the rare verb karah ("purchase/trade for," distinct from the homonymous karah "dig").
notes.2:13: Hebrew nachal ("wadi") denotes a seasonal stream-bed and its valley or gorge, distinguishing it from gay ("valley") in 3:29.
notes.2:15: "Rout them" translates le-hummam, the Qal infinitive construct of hamam ("throw into panic, rout, crush"), portraying divine judgment driving the rebellious generation out of the camp until they perished.
notes.2:33: The Masoretic text spells "his sons" defectively as banaw (without the yod of the plural suffix -ayw), though its vocalization reads the plural "his sons" rather than singular "his son."
