native_verses.9:23: And when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, "Go up and take possession of the land that I have given to you," you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God; you did not trust Him, and you did not listen to His voice.
native_verses.9:24: You have been rebelling against the LORD since the day I knew you.
native_verses.9:25: So I fell prostrate before the LORD for the forty days and the forty nights that I prostrated myself, because the LORD had said He would wipe you out.
native_verses.9:26: And I prayed to the LORD and said, "Lord GOD, do not destroy Your people and Your inheritance, whom You redeemed through Your greatness, whom You brought out of Egypt with a strong hand.
native_verses.9:27: Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; do not pay attention to the stubbornness of this people, or to their wickedness, or to their sin.
native_verses.9:28: Otherwise, the land from which You brought us out will say, 'Because the LORD was unable to bring them into the land that He spoke of to them, and because He hated them, He brought them out to put them to death in the wilderness.'
native_verses.9:29: Yet they are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You brought out with Your great strength and with Your outstretched arm."
native_verses.10:1: At that time the LORD said to me, "Carve for yourself two stone tablets like the first ones, and come up to Me on the mountain, and make for yourself a wooden ark.
native_verses.10:2: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you shattered, and you are to place them in the ark."
native_verses.10:3: So I made an ark of acacia wood, carved two stone tablets like the first ones, and went up the mountain with the two tablets in my hand.
native_verses.10:4: And He wrote on the tablets, like the first writing, the Ten Words that the LORD spoke to you on the mountain from within the fire on the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me.
native_verses.10:5: Then I turned and went down from the mountain, and placed the tablets in the ark that I had made; and there they remain, just as the LORD commanded me.
native_verses.10:6: And the sons of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah. Aaron died there and was buried there, and his son Eleazar served as priest in his place.
native_verses.10:7: From there they traveled to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of streams of water.
native_verses.10:8: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister to Him, and to bless in His name, down to this day.
native_verses.10:9: For this reason Levi has no share or inheritance with his brothers; the LORD Himself is his inheritance, just as the LORD your God spoke to him.
native_verses.10:10: And I remained on the mountain as during the first days, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD listened to me that time as well: the LORD was unwilling to destroy you.
native_verses.10:11: Then the LORD said to me, "Get up, go on the journey ahead of the people, so that they may enter and take possession of the land that I swore to their fathers to give to them."
native_verses.10:12: And now, Israel, what is the LORD your God asking from you, except to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, and to love Him, and to serve the LORD your God with your whole heart and with your whole soul,
native_verses.10:13: to observe the commandments of the LORD and His statutes that I am commanding you today, for your own good?
native_verses.10:14: See, to the LORD your God belong the heavens and the heaven of heavens, the earth and everything that is in it.
native_verses.10:15: Yet the LORD fixed His affection on your fathers alone, to love them, and He chose their seed after them—you—out of all the peoples, as it is this day.
native_verses.10:16: So circumcise the foreskin of your heart, and do not stiffen your neck any longer.
native_verses.10:17: For the LORD your God, He is God of gods and Lord of lords, the God who is great, mighty, and awe-inspiring, who shows no partiality and accepts no bribe.
native_verses.10:18: He carries out justice for the fatherless and the widow, and loves the foreign resident, giving him bread and clothing.
native_verses.10:19: Therefore you are to love the foreign resident, because you were foreign residents in the land of Egypt.
native_verses.10:20: The LORD your God you must fear; Him you must serve, and to Him you must cling, and by His name you must swear.
native_verses.10:21: He is your praise, and He is your God, who has done for you these great and awe-inspiring deeds that your eyes have seen.
native_verses.10:22: As seventy persons your fathers went down to Egypt, and now the LORD your God has made you like the stars of the heavens in multitude.
native_verses.11:1: So you shall love the LORD your God, and you shall keep His charge, His statutes, His judgments, and His commandments at all times.
native_verses.11:2: And know today—for I am not addressing your children, who have not known and who have not seen—the discipline of the LORD your God, His greatness, His strong hand, and His outstretched arm,
native_verses.11:3: and His signs and His deeds that He did in the midst of Egypt to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and to all his land,
native_verses.11:4: and what He did to the army of Egypt, to its horses and to its chariots, how He made the waters of the Sea of Reeds flow over them as they pursued after you, and the LORD destroyed them to this day,
native_verses.11:5: and what He did for you in the wilderness until you arrived at this place,
native_verses.11:6: and what He did to Dathan and to Abiram, the sons of Eliab, son of Reuben, how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, along with their households, their tents, and every living thing that was at their feet in the midst of all Israel;
native_verses.11:7: for it is your own eyes that saw all the great work of the LORD that He did.
native_verses.11:8: So you shall keep the entire commandment that I am commanding you today, in order that you may be strong, and enter and possess the land that you are crossing over to possess,
native_verses.11:9: and in order that you may lengthen your days on the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them and to their seed, a land flowing with milk and honey.
native_verses.11:10: For the land that you are entering to possess is not like the land of Egypt from which you came out, where you would sow your seed and water it with your foot like a vegetable garden.
native_verses.11:11: Rather, the land that you are crossing over to possess is a land of mountains and valleys; it drinks water from the rain of the heavens,
native_verses.11:12: a land that the LORD your God looks after; continually the eyes of the LORD your God are upon it, from the beginning of the year to the end of the year.
native_verses.11:13: And it will come about, if you carefully listen to My commandments that I am commanding you today, to love the LORD your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,
native_verses.11:14: that I will give the rain of your land in its season, the early rain and the late rain, and you will gather your grain, your new wine, and your fresh oil.
native_verses.11:15: And I will give grass in your field for your livestock, and you will eat and be satisfied.
native_verses.11:16: Guard yourselves, or else your heart will be enticed, and you will turn aside and serve other gods and bow down to them,
native_verses.11:17: and the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and He will shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, and the ground will not give its yield, and you will perish quickly off the good land that the LORD is giving you.
native_verses.11:18: So you shall set these words of mine upon your heart and upon your soul, and you shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.
native_verses.11:19: And you shall teach them to your children, speaking about them when you sit in your house, when you walk on the road, when you lie down, and when you rise up.
native_verses.11:20: And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates,
native_verses.11:21: in order that your days and the days of your children may multiply on the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give them, like the days of the heavens above the earth.
native_verses.11:22: For if you carefully keep this entire commandment that I am commanding you to do, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, and to cling to Him,
native_verses.11:23: then the LORD will dispossess all these nations from before you, and you will dispossess nations larger and stronger than you.
native_verses.11:24: Every place where the sole of your foot treads will belong to you; from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the River Euphrates, as far as the western sea will be your territory.
native_verses.11:25: No one will stand firm before you; the LORD your God will put the dread of you and the fear of you over the face of all the land where you tread, just as He spoke to you.
native_verses.11:26: See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse:
native_verses.11:27: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God that I am commanding you today,
native_verses.11:28: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside from the way that I am commanding you today to go after other gods that you have not known.
native_verses.11:29: And it will come about, when the LORD your God brings you into the land that you are entering to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
native_verses.11:30: Are they not across the Jordan, beyond the road toward the setting sun, in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Arabah, opposite Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?
native_verses.11:31: For you are crossing the Jordan to enter and possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you, and you will possess it and live in it.
native_verses.11:32: And you shall be careful to do all the statutes and the judgments that I am setting before you today.
native_verses.12:1: These are the statutes and the judgments that you shall be careful to do in the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess, all the days that you live on the earth.
native_verses.12:2: You shall completely destroy all the places where the nations whom you are dispossessing served their gods, on the high mountains, on the hills, and under every lush tree.
native_verses.12:3: And you shall tear down their altars, shatter their sacred pillars, and burn their Asherah poles with fire; and you shall cut down the carved images of their gods and destroy their name from that place.
native_verses.12:4: You shall not do like this to the LORD your God.
native_verses.12:5: Instead, you shall seek out the place that the LORD your God will choose from all your tribes to put His name there, His dwelling place, and there you shall come.
native_verses.12:6: And there you shall bring your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and the contribution of your hand, your vows and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock.
native_verses.12:7: And there you shall eat before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice in every undertaking of your hand, you and your households, in which the LORD your God has blessed you.
native_verses.12:8: You shall not do according to all that we are doing here today, each man whatever is right in his own eyes,
native_verses.12:9: for up to now you have not come to the resting place and to the inheritance that the LORD your God is giving you.
native_verses.12:10: But when you cross the Jordan and live in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to inherit, and He gives you rest from all your enemies on every side so that you live in security,
native_verses.12:11: then to the place that the LORD your God will choose to make His name dwell, there you shall bring all that I am commanding you: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and the contribution of your hand, and all the choicest of your vows that you vow to the LORD.
native_verses.12:12: And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God, you, your sons and your daughters, your male slaves and your female slaves, and the Levite who is within your gates, since he has no portion or inheritance with you.
native_verses.12:13: Guard yourself that you do not offer up your burnt offerings in every place that you see;
native_verses.12:14: rather, in the place that the LORD will choose in one of your tribes, there you shall offer up your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I am commanding you.
native_verses.12:15: However, to the full desire of your soul you may slaughter and eat meat, according to the blessing of the LORD your God that He has given you within all your gates; the unclean and the clean may eat it, like the gazelle and like the deer.
native_verses.12:16: Only the blood you shall not eat; you shall pour it out on the ground like water.
native_verses.12:17: You are not permitted to eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, your new wine, or your fresh oil, or the firstborn of your herd or your flock, or any of your vows that you vow, or your freewill offerings, or the contribution of your hand;
native_verses.12:18: rather, you shall eat them before the LORD your God in the place that the LORD your God will choose—you, your son and your daughter, your male slave and your female slave, and the Levite who is within your gates—and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in every undertaking of your hand.
native_verses.12:19: Guard yourself that you do not forsake the Levite all your days on your land.
native_verses.12:20: When the LORD your God enlarges your territory, just as He spoke to you, and you say, "I will eat meat," because your soul desires to eat meat, then you may eat meat to the full desire of your soul.
native_verses.12:21: If the place that the LORD your God will choose to put His name there is too far from you, then you may slaughter from your herd and from your flock that the LORD has given you, just as I have commanded you, and you may eat within your gates to the full desire of your soul.
native_verses.12:22: Indeed, just as the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you may eat it; the unclean and the clean together may eat it.
native_verses.12:23: Only be firm not to eat the blood, for the blood is the life, and you shall not eat the life with the meat.
native_verses.12:24: You shall not eat it; onto the ground you shall pour it out like water.
native_verses.12:25: You shall not eat it, in order that it may go well for you and for your children after you, because you do what is right in the eyes of the LORD.
native_verses.12:26: Only the holy things that are yours, and your vows, you shall carry and come to the place that the LORD will choose.
native_verses.12:27: And you shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on the altar of the LORD your God; and the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on the altar of the LORD your God, and the meat you shall eat.
native_verses.12:28: Be careful to listen to all these words that I am commanding you, in order that it may go well for you and for your children after you forever, because you do what is good and right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
native_verses.12:29: When the LORD your God cuts off from before you the nations whom you are entering to dispossess, and you dispossess them and live in their land,
native_verses.12:30: guard yourself that you are not ensnared into following them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you do not inquire about their gods, saying, "How did these nations serve their gods, so that I too may do the same?"
native_verses.12:31: You shall not do like this to the LORD your God, for every abomination to the LORD that He hates they have done for their gods; indeed, even their sons and their daughters they burn in the fire for their gods.
native_verses.13:1: Every word that I am commanding you, you shall take care to do it; you shall not add to it, and you shall not subtract from it.
native_verses.13:2: If a prophet or a dreamer of a dream rises up in your midst and gives you a sign or a wonder,
native_verses.13:3: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass about which he spoke to you, saying, "Let us go after other gods"—whom you have not known—"and let us serve them,"
native_verses.13:4: you must not listen to the words of that prophet or to the dreamer of that dream, because the LORD your God is testing you to know whether you love the LORD your God with your whole heart and with your whole soul.
native_verses.13:5: You shall walk after the LORD your God, and you shall fear Him; you shall keep His commandments and listen to His voice; you shall serve Him and cling to Him.
native_verses.13:6: Now that prophet or the dreamer of that dream shall be put to death, because he spoke rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt and ransomed you from the house of slaves, to lead you astray from the path on which the LORD your God commanded you to walk. So you shall sweep away the evil from your midst.
native_verses.13:7: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is like your own soul, incites you in secret, saying, "Let us go and serve other gods"—whom you have not known, you and your fathers,
native_verses.13:8: of the gods of the peoples around you, those near to you or those far from you, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth—
native_verses.13:9: you must not consent to him, nor listen to him; your eye must not spare him, nor must you show compassion or cover for him.
native_verses.13:10: Instead, you shall certainly kill him; your hand shall be against him first to put him to death, and the hand of all the people afterward.
native_verses.13:11: And you shall stone him with stones so that he dies, because he sought to lead you astray from the LORD your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves.
native_verses.13:12: And all Israel will hear and be afraid, and they will not again do anything like this evil thing in your midst.
native_verses.13:13: If you hear in one of your cities that the LORD your God is giving you to dwell there, saying,
native_verses.13:14: "Worthless men have gone out from your midst and have led the residents of their city astray, saying, 'Let us go and serve other gods'"—whom you have not known—
native_verses.13:15: then you shall inquire, examine, and question thoroughly; and look, if the matter is true and confirmed, that this abomination has been done in your midst,
native_verses.13:16: you shall certainly strike down the residents of that city with the edge of the sword, devoting it to destruction—along with everything that is in it and its livestock—with the edge of the sword.
native_verses.13:17: You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its public square and burn the city and all its plunder with fire as a whole offering to the LORD your God. It shall become a ruin mound forever; it shall not be built again.
native_verses.13:18: Nothing from what is devoted to destruction shall cling to your hand, so that the LORD may turn from His burning anger and grant you compassion, show you mercy, and multiply you, just as He swore to your fathers,
native_verses.13:19: if you listen to the voice of the LORD your God by keeping all His commandments that I am commanding you today, doing what is right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
native_verses.14:1: You are sons of the LORD your God. You shall not gash yourselves, nor make a bald spot between your eyes for the dead.
native_verses.14:2: Because you are a holy people to the LORD your God, and it is you whom the LORD has chosen to be for Him a treasured people out of all the peoples who are on the face of the earth.
native_verses.14:3: You must not eat any abomination.
native_verses.14:4: These are the animals that you may eat: ox, sheep, and goat;
native_verses.14:5: deer, gazelle, fallow deer, wild goat, addax, oryx, and mountain sheep.
native_verses.14:6: And every animal that parts the hoof, having a cleft splitting it into two hooves, and chews the cud among the animals—that one you may eat.
native_verses.14:7: However, these you must not eat from among those that chew the cud or those that part the cleft hoof: the camel, the hare, and the rock hyrax, for although they chew the cud, they do not part the hoof; they are unclean to you.
native_verses.14:8: And the pig, because it parts the hoof yet does not chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat from their flesh, and you shall not touch their carcasses.
native_verses.14:9: These you may eat from all that are in the waters: everything that has fins and scales you may eat.
native_verses.14:10: Yet everything that does not have fins and scales you must not eat; it is unclean to you.
native_verses.14:11: Every clean bird you may eat.
native_verses.14:12: Yet these are the ones among them that you must not eat: the eagle, the bearded vulture, and the osprey;
native_verses.14:13: the buzzard, the falcon, and the kite according to its kind;
native_verses.14:14: every raven according to its kind;
native_verses.14:15: the ostrich, the nighthawk, the seagull, and the hawk according to its kind;
native_verses.14:16: the little owl, the great owl, and the barn owl;
native_verses.14:17: the desert owl, the Egyptian vulture, and the cormorant;
native_verses.14:18: the stork, the heron according to its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.
native_verses.14:19: And every winged swarming creature is unclean to you; they must not be eaten.
native_verses.14:20: Every clean winged creature you may eat.
native_verses.14:21: You must not eat any animal that died naturally; you may give it to the resident alien who is within your gates so that he may eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner, because you are a holy people to the LORD your God. You must not boil a young goat in the milk of its mother.
native_verses.14:22: You must certainly tithe all the produce of your seed that comes forth from the field year by year.
native_verses.14:23: And you shall eat before the LORD your God, in the place that He chooses to cause His name to dwell there, the tithe of your grain, your new wine, and your fresh oil, and the firstborn of your herd and your flock, in order that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.
native_verses.14:24: And if the journey is too long for you, so that you cannot carry it, because the place that the LORD your God chooses to place His name there is too far from you when the LORD your God blesses you,
native_verses.14:25: then you shall trade it for silver, tie up the silver in your hand, and go to the place that the LORD your God chooses.
native_verses.14:26: You may spend the silver on whatever your soul longs for—on cattle or sheep, on wine or strong drink, or on anything your soul asks of you—and you shall eat there before the LORD your God and rejoice, you and your household.
native_verses.14:27: And the Levite who is within your gates you must not forsake, because he has no share or inheritance with you.
native_verses.14:28: At the end of three years, you shall bring out the entire tithe of your produce in that year and store it within your gates.
native_verses.14:29: Then the Levite—because he has no share or inheritance with you—and the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, eat, and be satisfied, so that the LORD your God may bless you in every work of your hand that you do.
native_verses.15:1: At the end of seven years you shall observe a release.
native_verses.15:2: And these are the terms of the release: every holder of a loan shall release what he has lent to his neighbor; he must not demand payment from his neighbor or his brother, because a release to the LORD has been proclaimed.
native_verses.15:3: From a foreigner you may demand payment, but whatever belongs to you with your brother your hand shall release.
native_verses.15:4: Yet there will be no needy person among you, because the LORD will certainly bless you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance to possess,
native_verses.15:5: if only you diligently listen to the voice of the LORD your God, taking care to perform this entire commandment that I am commanding you today.
native_verses.15:6: Because the LORD your God will bless you just as He promised you, you will lend to many nations, while you yourself will not borrow; and you will rule over many nations, yet over you they will not rule.
native_verses.15:7: If there is among you a needy person, one of your brothers in any of your gates within your land that the LORD your God is giving you, you must not harden your heart or clench your hand against your needy brother.
native_verses.15:8: Instead, you shall open your hand wide to him and surely lend him enough for his need, whatever he lacks.
native_verses.15:9: Watch yourself so that there is no worthless thought in your heart, saying, "The seventh year, the year of release, has drawn near," and your eye turns begrudging toward your needy brother and you give him nothing; then he will cry out against you to the LORD, and sin will be in you.
native_verses.15:10: You shall certainly give to him, and your heart must not be begrudging when you give to him; for on account of this matter the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in everything to which you put your hand.
native_verses.15:11: For the needy will never cease from the midst of the land; therefore I am commanding you, saying, "You shall open your hand wide to your brother, to your poor, and to your needy in your land."
native_verses.15:12: If your brother—a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman—is sold to you, he shall serve you for six years, and in the seventh year you shall send him away free from you.
native_verses.15:13: And when you send him away free from you, you must not send him away empty-handed.
native_verses.15:14: You shall supply him generously from your flock, from your threshing floor, and from your winepress; from what the LORD your God has blessed you with, you shall give to him.
native_verses.15:15: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God ransomed you; therefore I am commanding you this matter today.
native_verses.15:16: And it shall be that if he says to you, "I will not go out from you"—because he loves you and your household, since it goes well for him with you—
native_verses.15:17: then you shall take the awl and put it through his ear and into the door, and he shall become your slave forever; and to your female slave also you shall do likewise.
native_verses.15:18: It must not seem hard in your eyes when you send him away free from you, because he has served you six years, worth double the wages of a hired worker; and the LORD your God will bless you in everything that you do.
native_verses.15:19: Every firstborn male that is born in your herd and in your flock you shall consecrate to the LORD your God. You must not work with the firstborn of your ox, and you must not shear the firstborn of your flock.
native_verses.15:20: Before the LORD your God you shall eat it year by year in the place that the LORD chooses, you and your household.
native_verses.15:21: Yet if there is a defect in it—if it is lame or blind, any severe defect—you must not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.
native_verses.15:22: Within your gates you may eat it, the unclean and the clean together, like the gazelle and like the deer.
native_verses.15:23: Only its blood you must not eat; you shall pour it out onto the ground like water.
native_verses.16:1: Keep the month of Abib and celebrate Passover to the LORD your God, because in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out from Egypt at night.
native_verses.16:2: You shall sacrifice Passover to the LORD your God, of flock and herd, in the place that the LORD will choose to cause His name to dwell there.
native_verses.16:3: You shall not eat anything leavened with it; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread with it, bread of affliction, because you went out from the land of Egypt in haste, so that you may remember the day of your going out from the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
native_verses.16:4: No leaven shall be seen with you within all your territory for seven days, and nothing of the meat that you sacrifice in the evening on the first day shall stay overnight until morning.
native_verses.16:5: You may not sacrifice the Passover in any one of your gates that the LORD your God is giving to you.
native_verses.16:6: Rather, at the place that the LORD your God will choose to cause His name to dwell, there you shall sacrifice the Passover in the evening as the sun goes down, the appointed time of your going out from Egypt.
native_verses.16:7: You shall cook and eat in the place that the LORD your God will choose, and in the morning you shall turn and go to your tents.
native_verses.16:8: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD your God; you shall not do any work.
native_verses.16:9: Seven weeks you shall count for yourself; from the beginning of the sickle in the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.
native_verses.16:10: Then you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God with the measure of a freewill offering from your hand, which you shall give according to how the LORD your God blesses you.
native_verses.16:11: And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God—you, your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, the Levite who is in your gates, and the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow who are in your midst—in the place that the LORD your God will choose to cause His name to dwell there.
native_verses.16:12: And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and you shall keep and carry out these statutes.
native_verses.16:13: You shall celebrate the Feast of Booths for yourself for seven days, when you gather in from your threshing floor and from your winepress.
native_verses.16:14: And you shall rejoice in your feast—you, your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite, the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow who are in your gates.
native_verses.16:15: For seven days you shall hold a feast to the LORD your God in the place that the LORD will choose, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your yield and in all the work of your hands, and you will be nothing but joyful.
native_verses.16:16: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the LORD your God in the place that He will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Booths; and none shall appear before the LORD empty-handed.
native_verses.16:17: Each man shall give according to the gift of his hand, according to the blessing of the LORD your God that He has given to you.
native_verses.16:18: You shall appoint judges and officials for yourself in all your gates that the LORD your God is giving to you throughout your tribes, and they shall judge the people with just judgment.
native_verses.16:19: You shall not bend justice; you shall not be partial, and you shall not accept a bribe, because a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and overturns the words of the righteous.
native_verses.16:20: Justice, justice you shall pursue, so that you may live and take possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving to you.
native_verses.16:21: You shall not plant for yourself an Asherah of any tree beside the altar of the LORD your God that you will make for yourself.
native_verses.16:22: And you shall not erect for yourself a standing stone, which the LORD your God hates.
native_verses.17:1: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep in which there is a blemish, anything bad, because that is an abomination to the LORD your God.
native_verses.17:2: If there is found in your midst, in any one of your gates that the LORD your God is giving to you, a man or a woman who does what is evil in the eyes of the LORD your God, transgressing His covenant,
native_verses.17:3: and goes and serves other gods and bows down to them, or to the sun or to the moon or to any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded,
native_verses.17:4: and it is reported to you and you hear of it, you shall inquire thoroughly; and now, if it is true, the matter confirmed, that this abomination has been done in Israel,
native_verses.17:5: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates—the man or the woman—and you shall stone them with stones, and they shall die.
native_verses.17:6: By the testimony of two witnesses or three witnesses the one to die shall be put to death; he shall not be put to death by the testimony of one witness.
native_verses.17:7: The hand of the witnesses shall be upon him first to put him to death, and the hand of all the people last; and you shall purge the evil from your midst.
native_verses.17:8: If a matter for judgment is too difficult for you—between blood and blood, between lawsuit and lawsuit, and between blow and blow, matters of dispute in your gates—then you shall rise and go up to the place that the LORD your God will choose.
native_verses.17:9: You shall come to the Levitical priests and to the judge who will be in those days; you shall inquire, and they shall declare to you the word of judgment.
native_verses.17:10: And you shall act according to the word that they declare to you from that place which the LORD will choose, and you shall take care to do according to all that they teach you.
native_verses.17:11: According to the teaching that they teach you and according to the judgment that they speak to you, you shall act; you shall not turn aside from the word that they declare to you, to the right or to the left.
native_verses.17:12: As for the man who acts in presumption by not listening to the priest who stands to minister there to the LORD your God, or to the judge—that man shall die, and you shall purge the evil from Israel.
native_verses.17:13: And all the people will hear and fear, and they will not act presumptuously anymore.
native_verses.17:14: When you come into the land that the LORD your God is giving to you, and take possession of it and settle in it, and say, "Let me set a king over myself, like all the nations surrounding me,"
native_verses.17:15: you shall certainly set over yourself a king whom the LORD your God will choose. From the midst of your brothers you shall set a king over yourself; you may not place over yourself a foreign man, one who is not your brother.
native_verses.17:16: Only, he shall not multiply horses for himself, nor make the people return to Egypt in order to multiply horses, for the LORD has told you, "You shall not return along this way anymore."
native_verses.17:17: And he shall not multiply wives for himself, so that his heart does not turn aside, nor shall he greatly multiply silver and gold for himself.
native_verses.17:18: And when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, he shall write for himself a copy of this law on a scroll from before the Levitical priests.
native_verses.17:19: It shall remain with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, keeping all the words of this law and these statutes to carry them out,
native_verses.17:20: so that his heart may not rise above his brothers and he may not turn aside from the commandment to the right or to the left, in order that he may lengthen his days over his kingdom, he and his sons, in the midst of Israel.
native_verses.18:1: The Levitical priests, the entire tribe of Levi, shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel; they shall eat the fire offerings of the LORD and His inheritance.
native_verses.18:2: And he shall have no inheritance in the midst of his brothers; the LORD Himself is his inheritance, as He spoke to him.
native_verses.18:3: And this shall be the rightful due of the priests from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether ox or sheep: one shall give to the priest the foreleg, the two cheeks, and the stomach.
native_verses.18:4: The firstfruits of your grain, your new wine, and your fresh oil, and the first of the shearing of your flock, you shall give to him.
native_verses.18:5: For the LORD your God has chosen him from all your tribes to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, he and his sons always.
native_verses.18:6: And if a Levite comes from any one of your gates out of all Israel where he sojourns, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place that the LORD will choose,
native_verses.18:7: then he may minister in the name of the LORD his God, just like all his brothers the Levites who stand there before the LORD.
native_verses.18:8: They shall eat portion for portion, apart from his sales of ancestral property.
native_verses.18:9: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving to you, you shall not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations.
native_verses.18:10: No one shall be found among you who causes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, a practitioner of divination, a soothsayer, an omen reader, or a sorcerer,
native_verses.18:11: or a caster of spells, or one who consults a medium or a spiritist, or one who inquires of the dead.
native_verses.18:12: Because everyone who does these things is an abomination to the LORD, and on account of these abominations the LORD your God is dispossessing them from before you.
native_verses.18:13: You shall be blameless with the LORD your God.
native_verses.18:14: For these nations that you are dispossessing listen to soothsayers and to diviners; but as for you, the LORD your God has not permitted this to you.
native_verses.18:15: The LORD your God will raise up a prophet for you from your midst, from your brothers, like me; to him you shall listen,
native_verses.18:16: according to all that you requested from the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, saying, "May I not hear the voice of the LORD my God again, and may I not see this great fire anymore, so that I will not die."
native_verses.18:17: And the LORD said to me, "They have done well in what they have spoken.
native_verses.18:18: I will raise up a prophet for them from the midst of their brothers, like you, and I will place My words in his mouth, and he will speak to them everything that I command him.
native_verses.18:19: And it shall be that the man who does not listen to My words that he speaks in My name—I Myself will demand an accounting from him.
native_verses.18:20: Yet the prophet who acts presumptuously in speaking a word in My name that I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die."
native_verses.18:21: And if you say in your heart, "How can we know the word that the LORD has not spoken?"
native_verses.18:22: When a prophet speaks in the name of the LORD and the word does not happen or come about, that is the word that the LORD has not spoken. In presumption the prophet has spoken it; you shall not dread him.
native_verses.19:1: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations whose land the LORD your God is giving to you, and you dispossess them and live in their cities and in their houses,
native_verses.19:2: you are to set apart three cities for yourself within your land, which the LORD your God is giving to you to possess.
native_verses.19:3: You are to prepare the road for yourself and divide into three parts the territory of your land that the LORD your God is granting you as an inheritance, so that every killer may flee there.
native_verses.19:4: And this is the case of the killer who may flee there and live: one who strikes his neighbor unintentionally, without having hated him beforehand.
native_verses.19:5: When someone goes with his neighbor into the forest to chop wood, and his hand swings with the axe to cut down the tree, and the iron slips off the wood and hits his neighbor so that he dies, that person may flee to one of these cities and live.
native_verses.19:6: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might chase after the killer while his heart is hot, and overtake him because the road is long, and strike him fatally, even though no sentence of death applied to him, since he had not hated him beforehand.
native_verses.19:7: Therefore I am commanding you, saying, "You are to set apart three cities for yourself."
native_verses.19:8: And if the LORD your God expands your territory, just as He swore to your fathers, and gives you all the land that He spoke of giving to your fathers,
native_verses.19:9: provided you keep this entire commandment to carry it out, which I am commanding you today, to love the LORD your God and to walk in His ways at all times, then you are to add three more cities for yourself in addition to these three,
native_verses.19:10: so that innocent blood will not be shed in the midst of your land, which the LORD your God is giving to you as an inheritance, and bloodguilt will not rest upon you.
native_verses.19:11: But if a man hates his neighbor and lies in wait for him, and rises up against him and strikes him fatally so that he dies, and he flees to one of these cities,
native_verses.19:12: then the elders of his city are to send and take him from there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood so that he dies.
native_verses.19:13: Your eye must not show pity on him, and you must purge the blood of the innocent from Israel, so that it may go well for you.
native_verses.19:14: You must not move back your neighbor's boundary, which earlier generations marked out, in your inheritance that you will inherit in the land which the LORD your God is giving to you to possess.
native_verses.19:15: A single witness must not stand against a man for any iniquity or for any sin, regarding any offense he may commit; on the word of two witnesses or on the word of three witnesses a matter shall stand.
native_verses.19:16: If a malicious witness rises against a man to testify against him of a transgression,
native_verses.19:17: then the two men who have the dispute are to stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges who will be in those days.
native_verses.19:18: And the judges must investigate thoroughly; and if indeed the witness is a false witness, having testified falsely against his brother,
native_verses.19:19: then you are to do to him just as he schemed to do to his brother, and you must purge the evil from your midst.
native_verses.19:20: And the rest will hear and be afraid, and will not again do anything like this evil thing in your midst.
native_verses.19:21: And your eye must not show pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
native_verses.20:1: When you go out to war against your enemies and see horses and chariots, a people more numerous than you, do not be afraid of them, for the LORD your God is with you, the One who brought you up from the land of Egypt.
native_verses.20:2: And when you draw near to the battle, the priest shall step forward and speak to the people.
native_verses.20:3: And he shall say to them, "Hear, Israel, you are drawing near today for battle against your enemies. Do not let your heart grow faint; do not be afraid, do not panic, and do not be terrified before them,
native_verses.20:4: for the LORD your God is the One going with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to deliver you."
native_verses.20:5: Then the officers shall speak to the people, saying, "Who is the man who has built a new house and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, or else he might die in the battle and another man dedicate it.
native_verses.20:6: And who is the man who has planted a vineyard and has not put it to ordinary use? Let him go and return to his house, or else he might die in the battle and another man put it to ordinary use.
native_verses.20:7: And who is the man who has betrothed a woman and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, or else he might die in the battle and another man take her."
native_verses.20:8: And the officers shall speak further to the people and say, "Who is the man who is fearful and faint of heart? Let him go and return to his house, so that the heart of his brothers will not melt like his own heart."
native_verses.20:9: And when the officers finish speaking to the people, they are to appoint commanders of armies at the head of the people.
native_verses.20:10: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, you must call out to it for peace.
native_verses.20:11: And if it answers you with peace and opens to you, then all the people who are found in it shall become forced labor for you and serve you.
native_verses.20:12: But if it does not make peace with you, and makes war with you, then you shall besiege it.
native_verses.20:13: And when the LORD your God gives it into your hand, you are to strike down all its males with the edge of the sword.
native_verses.20:14: Only the women and the little ones and the livestock and everything that is in the city, all its spoil, you may plunder for yourself; and you may consume the spoil of your enemies, which the LORD your God has given to you.
native_verses.20:15: Thus you are to do to all the cities that are very far from you, which are not among the cities of these nations.
native_verses.20:16: Only from the cities of these peoples, which the LORD your God is giving to you as an inheritance, you must not keep alive anything that breathes.
native_verses.20:17: Rather, you must completely devote them to destruction, the Hittites and the Amorites, the Canaanites and the Perizzites, the Hivites and the Jebusites, just as the LORD your God has commanded you,
native_verses.20:18: so that they will not teach you to do according to all their detestable practices that they have done for their gods, and you sin against the LORD your God.
native_verses.20:19: When you besiege a city for many days, fighting against it to capture it, you must not destroy its trees by swinging an axe against them, for you may eat from them, and you must not cut them down. For is the tree of the field a human being, that it should come under siege before you?
native_verses.20:20: Only trees that you know are not food trees, those you may destroy and cut down, and construct siegeworks against the city that is making war with you until it falls.
native_verses.21:1: If someone who has been killed is found in the land that the LORD your God is giving to you to possess, fallen in the field, and it is not known who struck him,
native_verses.21:2: then your elders and your judges shall go out and measure to the cities that are around the one who was killed.
native_verses.21:3: And for the city that is nearest to the one who was killed, the elders of that city shall take a heifer from the herd that has not been worked, that has not pulled in a yoke.
native_verses.21:4: And the elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with a perennial stream, which is neither worked nor sown, and break the heifer's neck there in the valley.
native_verses.21:5: Then the priests, the sons of Levi, shall step forward, for the LORD your God has chosen them to minister to Him and to bless in the name of the LORD, and by their word every dispute and every assault is to be decided.
native_verses.21:6: And all the elders of that city who are nearest to the one who was killed shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.
native_verses.21:7: And they shall answer and say, "Our hands have not shed this blood, and our eyes have not seen it.
native_verses.21:8: Atone for Your people Israel, whom You have redeemed, LORD, and do not place innocent blood in the midst of Your people Israel." Then the blood shall be atoned for on their behalf.
native_verses.21:9: And you will purge the innocent blood from your midst when you do what is right in the eyes of the LORD.
native_verses.21:10: When you go out to war against your enemies, and the LORD your God gives them into your hand, and you take captives from them,
native_verses.21:11: and you see among the captives a woman of beautiful form, and you desire her and would take her for yourself as a wife,
native_verses.21:12: then you shall bring her inside your house, and she shall shave her head and trim her nails.
native_verses.21:13: She shall also remove the garment of her captivity from herself, and remain in your house and weep for her father and her mother a full month. After that, you may go in to her and be her husband, and she shall become your wife.
native_verses.21:14: And if you take no delight in her, then you are to send her away as she chooses; you must certainly not sell her for money. You must not treat her as a slave, because you have humbled her.
native_verses.21:15: If a man has two wives, one loved and the other hated, and they bear him sons, both the loved one and the hated one, and the firstborn son belongs to the hated one,
native_verses.21:16: then on the day he bequeaths to his sons what belongs to him, he may not treat the son of the loved one as firstborn ahead of the son of the hated one, who is the firstborn.
native_verses.21:17: Rather, he must recognize the firstborn, the son of the hated one, by giving him a double portion of all that is found belonging to him, for he is the firstfruits of his vigor; the right of the birthright belongs to him.
native_verses.21:18: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not listen to the voice of his father or to the voice of his mother, and though they discipline him he will not listen to them,
native_verses.21:19: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.
native_verses.21:20: And they shall say to the elders of his city, "This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious; he does not listen to our voice; he is a glutton and a drunkard."
native_verses.21:21: Then all the men of his city shall stone him with stones so that he dies, and you must purge the evil from your midst; and all Israel will hear and be afraid.
native_verses.21:22: And if a man has committed a sin carrying a sentence of death and is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,
native_verses.21:23: his corpse must not remain overnight on the tree; rather, you must certainly bury him on that day, for one who is hanged is a curse of God, so that you do not defile your land that the LORD your God is giving to you as an inheritance.
native_verses.22:1: You shall not see your brother's ox or his sheep wandering astray and hide yourself from them; you shall surely return them to your brother.
native_verses.22:2: If your brother is not near you, or you do not know him, you shall gather it inside your house, and it shall be with you until your brother searches for it, and you shall return it to him.
native_verses.22:3: And so you shall do with his donkey, and so you shall do with his garment, and so you shall do with every lost thing of your brother that is lost from him and that you find; you may not hide yourself.
native_verses.22:4: You shall not see your brother's donkey or his ox fallen on the road and hide yourself from them; you shall surely lift them up with him.
native_verses.22:5: A man's attire shall not be on a woman, and a man shall not wear a woman's garment, for everyone who does these things is an abomination to the LORD your God.
native_verses.22:6: If a bird's nest happens to be before you along the road, in any tree or on the ground, with chicks or eggs, and the mother is sitting on the chicks or on the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young.
native_verses.22:7: You shall surely send the mother away, and the young you may take for yourself, so that it may go well with you and you may lengthen your days.
native_verses.22:8: When you build a new house, then you shall make a parapet for your roof, and you shall not place bloodguilt on your house if someone falls from it.
native_verses.22:9: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, otherwise the full yield—the seed that you sow and the produce of the vineyard—will become consecrated.
native_verses.22:10: You shall not plow with an ox and with a donkey together.
native_verses.22:11: You shall not wear mixed fabric, wool and linen together.
native_verses.22:12: You shall make twisted tassels for yourself on the four corners of your cloak, with which you cover yourself.
native_verses.22:13: If a man takes a wife, and goes in to her, and hates her,
native_verses.22:14: and lays baseless charges against her, and brings out a bad name against her, and says, "I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I did not find signs of virginity in her,"
native_verses.22:15: then the father of the young woman and her mother shall take the signs of the young woman's virginity and bring them out to the elders of the city at the gate.
native_verses.22:16: And the father of the young woman shall say to the elders, "I gave my daughter to this man as a wife, and he hated her,
native_verses.22:17: and look, he has laid baseless charges, saying, 'I did not find signs of virginity in your daughter.' Yet these are the signs of my daughter's virginity." And they shall spread out the garment before the elders of the city.
native_verses.22:18: Then the elders of that city shall take the man and discipline him.
native_verses.22:19: And they shall fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give it to the father of the young woman, because he has brought out a bad name against a virgin of Israel. And she shall be his wife; he may not send her away all his days.
native_verses.22:20: But if this matter is true, that signs of virginity were not found for the young woman,
native_verses.22:21: then they shall bring the young woman out to the entrance of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones so that she dies, because she has done a disgraceful thing in Israel by committing sexual immorality in her father's house. And you shall purge the evil from your midst.
native_verses.22:22: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then both of them shall die—the man who lay with the woman, and the woman. And you shall purge the evil from Israel.
native_verses.22:23: If there is a young woman, a virgin betrothed to a man, and a man finds her in the city and lies with her,
native_verses.22:24: then you shall bring both of them out to the gate of that city, and stone them with stones so that they die—the young woman because she did not cry out in the city, and the man because he violated the wife of his neighbor. And you shall purge the evil from your midst.
native_verses.22:25: But if in the field the man finds the betrothed young woman, and the man overpowers her and lies with her, then the man who lay with her, he alone, shall die.
native_verses.22:26: And to the young woman you shall do nothing; the young woman has no sin deserving death, for just as when a man rises up against his neighbor and murders him, so is this matter.
native_verses.22:27: For he found her in the field; the betrothed young woman cried out, and there was no one to rescue her.
native_verses.22:28: If a man finds a young woman, a virgin who has not been betrothed, and takes hold of her and lies with her, and they are found,
native_verses.22:29: then the man who lay with her shall give fifty shekels of silver to the father of the young woman, and she shall be his wife because he violated her; he may not send her away all his days.
native_verses.23:1: A man shall not take his father's wife, and he shall not uncover the edge of his father's garment.
native_verses.23:2: No one wounded by crushing or having his male organ cut off shall enter the assembly of the LORD.
native_verses.23:3: A person of illicit birth shall not enter the assembly of the LORD; even a tenth generation of his shall not enter the assembly of the LORD.
native_verses.23:4: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter the assembly of the LORD; even a tenth generation of theirs shall not enter the assembly of the LORD forever,
native_verses.23:5: because they did not come to meet you with bread and water along the road as you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Aram-naharaim to curse you.
native_verses.23:6: Yet the LORD your God was unwilling to listen to Balaam; rather, the LORD your God turned the curse for you into a blessing, because the LORD your God loved you.
native_verses.23:7: You shall not seek their peace or their welfare all your days, forever.
native_verses.23:8: You shall not loathe an Edomite, for he is your brother; you shall not loathe an Egyptian, for you were a resident alien in his land.
native_verses.23:9: Children who are born to them—a third generation of theirs—may enter the assembly of the LORD.
native_verses.23:10: When you go out as a camp against your enemies, you shall guard yourself from every evil thing.
native_verses.23:11: If there is a man among you who is not clean from an occurrence at night, then he shall go outside the camp; he shall not enter into the midst of the camp.
native_verses.23:12: And as evening draws near, he shall bathe in water, and when the sun goes down, he may enter into the midst of the camp.
native_verses.23:13: And you shall have a designated place outside the camp, and there you shall go out.
native_verses.23:14: And you shall have a spade along with your equipment; and when you sit down outside, you shall dig with it, and turn back and cover your excrement.
native_verses.23:15: For the LORD your God walks about in the midst of your camp to rescue you and to hand your enemies over before you; so your camp shall be holy, that He may not see any indecent thing among you and turn back from following you.
native_verses.23:16: You shall not surrender to his master a slave who has escaped to you from his master.
native_verses.23:17: With you he shall live in your midst, in the place that he chooses in one of your gates, wherever it is good for him; you shall not oppress him.
native_verses.23:18: There shall not be a female shrine prostitute from among the daughters of Israel, and there shall not be a male shrine prostitute from among the sons of Israel.
native_verses.23:19: You shall not bring the earnings of a prostitute or the price of a dog into the house of the LORD your God for any vow, for both of them are an abomination to the LORD your God.
native_verses.23:20: You shall not lend at interest to your brother: interest on money, interest on food, interest on anything that may be lent at interest.
native_verses.23:21: To a foreigner you may lend at interest, but to your brother you shall not lend at interest, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to in the land that you are entering to possess.
native_verses.23:22: When you make a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not delay in paying it, for the LORD your God will surely demand it from you, and there will be sin in you.
native_verses.23:23: And if you refrain from vowing, there will be no sin in you.
native_verses.23:24: You shall keep and do what goes out from your lips, just as you vowed to the LORD your God as a freewill offering, what you spoke with your mouth.
native_verses.23:25: When you come into your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat grapes as you desire, to your fill, but you shall not put any into your container.
native_verses.23:26: When you come into your neighbor's standing grain, you may pluck heads of grain with your hand, but you shall not swing a sickle over your neighbor's standing grain.
native_verses.24:1: If a man takes a wife and becomes her husband, and it happens that she does not find favor in his eyes because he has found an indecent matter in her, so he writes her a document of divorce, places it in her hand, and sends her away from his house,
native_verses.24:2: and she departs from his house, goes away, and becomes the wife of another man,
native_verses.24:3: and if the second man hates her, writes her a document of divorce, places it in her hand, and sends her away from his house, or if the second man who took her to himself as a wife dies,
native_verses.24:4: then her first husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she has been defiled, for that is an abomination before the LORD. And do not bring guilt of sin on the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
native_verses.24:5: When a man takes a new wife, he must not go out with the army, nor may any duty be laid upon him. He is to be free for his home for one year and bring joy to his wife whom he has taken.
native_verses.24:6: No one may take a pair of millstones or an upper millstone as a pledge, because it is a life that he is taking as a pledge.
native_verses.24:7: If a man is found stealing a person from his brothers among the sons of Israel, and he deals brutally with him and sells him, then that thief must die. You must purge the evil from your midst.
native_verses.24:8: Guard yourself in an affliction of skin disease, observing very carefully and acting according to everything that the Levitical priests instruct you; just as I commanded them, so be careful to do.
native_verses.24:9: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam along the way when you came out from Egypt.
native_verses.24:10: When you make a loan of anything to your neighbor, do not enter his house to collect his pledge.
native_verses.24:11: Stand outside, and the man to whom you are lending shall bring the pledge outside to you.
native_verses.24:12: And if he is a poor man, do not lie down with his pledge.
native_verses.24:13: You must certainly return the pledge to him as the sun sets, so that he may lie down in his cloak and bless you, and for you it will be righteousness before the LORD your God.
native_verses.24:14: You must not exploit a poor and needy hired laborer, whether one of your brothers or one of your resident aliens who is in your land, within your gates.
native_verses.24:15: On that very day you must give him his wages, and do not let the sun go down on it, because he is poor and sets his soul on it, so that he does not cry out against you to the LORD and sin be upon you.
native_verses.24:16: Fathers are not to be put to death on account of children, nor are children to be put to death on account of fathers; every person is to be put to death for his own sin.
native_verses.24:17: Do not distort the justice due a resident alien or a fatherless child, and do not take a widow's garment as a pledge.
native_verses.24:18: And remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you from there; that is why I am commanding you to do this thing.
native_verses.24:19: When you reap your harvest in your field and forget a sheaf in the field, you must not turn back to take it. It shall belong to the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow, so that the LORD your God may bless you in every work of your hands.
native_verses.24:20: When you beat your olive tree, do not go through the branches again behind you. It shall belong to the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow.
native_verses.24:21: When you harvest the grapes of your vineyard, do not glean behind you. It shall belong to the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow.
native_verses.24:22: And remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; that is why I am commanding you to do this thing.
native_verses.25:1: When a dispute arises between men and they come to court, and the judges pass judgment on them, they must vindicate the innocent and condemn the guilty.
native_verses.25:2: Then if the guilty man deserves a beating, the judge shall have him lie down and be beaten in his presence, with a number of blows matching his guilt.
native_verses.25:3: He may give him forty blows, but no more; otherwise, if he goes further and strikes him beyond these with a heavy beating, your brother will be humiliated before your eyes.
native_verses.25:4: Do not muzzle an ox as it threshes.
native_verses.25:5: When brothers live together and one of them dies and has no son, the dead man's wife must not marry outside to an unrelated man. Her husband's brother shall go in to her, take her to himself as his wife, and fulfill the duty of a husband's brother toward her.
native_verses.25:6: And the firstborn whom she bears shall carry on the name of his dead brother, so that his name is not wiped out from Israel.
native_verses.25:7: And if the man does not want to take his brother's wife, then his brother's wife shall go up to the gate, to the elders, and say, "My husband's brother has refused to raise up a name for his brother in Israel; he is unwilling to fulfill the duty of a husband's brother toward me."
native_verses.25:8: Then the elders of his city shall summon him and speak with him. If he stands firm and says, "I do not want to take her,"
native_verses.25:9: then his brother's wife shall approach him before the eyes of the elders, draw his sandal off his foot, and spit in his face; and she shall answer and say, "This is what is to be done to the man who does not build his brother's house."
native_verses.25:10: And in Israel his name shall be called, "The house of the one whose sandal was drawn off."
native_verses.25:11: When men fight together, a man and his brother, and the wife of one approaches to rescue her husband from the hand of the one striking him, and she reaches out her hand and grasps his private parts,
native_verses.25:12: then you must cut off her hand; your eye shall show no pity.
native_verses.25:13: You must not have unequal stone weights in your pouch, one large and one small.
native_verses.25:14: You must not have unequal ephah measures in your house, one large and one small.
native_verses.25:15: You must have a complete and just stone weight, and you must have a complete and just ephah measure, so that your days may be lengthened on the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
native_verses.25:16: For every person who does these things, every person who commits injustice, is an abomination to the LORD your God.
native_verses.25:17: Remember what Amalek did to you along the way when you came out from Egypt,
native_verses.25:18: how he encountered you on the way and cut off from your rear all the feeble ones behind you while you were faint and exhausted, and he did not fear God.
native_verses.25:19: So when the LORD your God has given you rest from all your enemies on every side, in the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance to possess, you must wipe out the memory of Amalek from beneath the heavens. You must not forget.
native_verses.26:1: Now when you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you take possession of it and settle in it,
native_verses.26:2: you must take a portion of the first of all the fruit of the soil that you bring in from your land, which the LORD your God is giving you, place it in a basket, and go to the place that the LORD your God will choose to have His name dwell there.
native_verses.26:3: You shall go to the priest who will be in those days and say to him, "Today I declare to the LORD your God that I have entered the land that the LORD swore to our fathers to give us."
native_verses.26:4: The priest shall then take the basket from your hand and set it down in front of the altar of the LORD your God.
native_verses.26:5: Then you shall answer and say before the LORD your God, "A perishing Aramean was my father; he went down to Egypt and resided there as an alien with few people, and there he became a great, mighty, and numerous nation.
native_verses.26:6: And the Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and placed harsh labor upon us.
native_verses.26:7: We cried out to the LORD, the God of our fathers, and the LORD listened to our voice and saw our affliction, our hardship, and our oppression.
native_verses.26:8: Then the LORD brought us out from Egypt with a strong hand and an extended arm, with great dread, and with signs and wonders.
native_verses.26:9: He brought us to this place and gave this land to us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
native_verses.26:10: And now, look, I have brought the first of the fruit of the soil that You have given to me, LORD." Then you must set it down before the LORD your God and bow down before the LORD your God.
native_verses.26:11: You shall rejoice in all the good that the LORD your God has given you and your household, you together with the Levite and the resident alien who is in your midst.
native_verses.26:12: When you have finished setting aside the entire tithe of your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, and have given it to the Levite, the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow, so that they may eat within your gates and be satisfied,
native_verses.26:13: then you shall say before the LORD your God, "I have cleared out the sacred portion from the house, and I have also given it to the Levite, the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow, according to Your whole command that You commanded me. I have not turned aside from Your commands, nor have I forgotten.
native_verses.26:14: I have not eaten any of it during my mourning, nor have I cleared out any of it while unclean, nor have I given any of it for the dead. I have listened to the voice of the LORD my God; I have acted according to everything that You commanded me.
native_verses.26:15: Look down from Your holy dwelling place, from the heavens, and bless Your people Israel and the soil that You have given to us, just as You swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey."
native_verses.26:16: This very day the LORD your God is commanding you to carry out these statutes and judgments; and you must keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.
native_verses.26:17: Today you have affirmed the LORD to be God for you, and that you will walk in His ways, keep His statutes, His commands, and His judgments, and listen to His voice.
native_verses.26:18: And today the LORD has affirmed you to be a people of treasured possession for Himself, just as He spoke to you, and that you are to keep all His commands,
native_verses.26:19: and that He will place you high above all the nations that He has made, for praise, for renown, and for splendor, and that you will be a holy people to the LORD your God, just as He has spoken.
native_verses.27:1: And Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, "Observe the entire commandment that I am commanding you today.
native_verses.27:2: And it will come about, on the day you cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD your God is giving to you, that you shall erect large stones for yourself and plaster them with lime.
native_verses.27:3: And you shall write on them all the words of this law when you cross over, so that you may come into the land that the LORD your God is giving to you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, promised you.
native_verses.27:4: And it will come about, when you cross the Jordan, that you shall erect on Mount Ebal these stones concerning which I am commanding you today, and you shall plaster them with lime.
native_verses.27:5: And you shall build an altar there to the LORD your God, an altar of stones; you shall not wield iron over them.
native_verses.27:6: With whole stones you shall build the altar of the LORD your God, and you shall offer up burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.
native_verses.27:7: And you shall sacrifice peace offerings, eat there, and rejoice in the presence of the LORD your God.
native_verses.27:8: And you shall write on the stones all the words of this law clearly and thoroughly."
native_verses.27:9: Then Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, "Keep silent and listen, Israel! On this day you have become a people belonging to the LORD your God.
native_verses.27:10: So you shall listen to the voice of the LORD your God and carry out His commandments and His statutes that I am commanding you today."
native_verses.27:11: And Moses commanded the people on that day, saying:
native_verses.27:12: "These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people when you cross the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
native_verses.27:13: And these shall stand for the curse on Mount Ebal: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
native_verses.27:14: Then the Levites shall speak out and say to every man of Israel with a loud voice:
native_verses.27:15: 'Cursed is the man who makes a carved image or a cast image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of a craftsman, and places it in secret.' And all the people shall respond and say, 'Amen.'
native_verses.27:16: 'Cursed is the one who treats his father or his mother with contempt.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
native_verses.27:17: 'Cursed is the one who shifts his neighbor's boundary.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
native_verses.27:18: 'Cursed is the one who leads a blind person astray on the road.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
native_verses.27:19: 'Cursed is the one who subverts the justice due a resident alien, a fatherless child, or a widow.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
native_verses.27:20: 'Cursed is the one who lies with his father's wife, because he has uncovered the edge of his father's garment.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
native_verses.27:21: 'Cursed is the one who lies with any animal.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
native_verses.27:22: 'Cursed is the one who lies with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
native_verses.27:23: 'Cursed is the one who lies with his mother-in-law.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
native_verses.27:24: 'Cursed is the one who strikes down his neighbor in secret.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
native_verses.27:25: 'Cursed is the one who takes a bribe to strike down a life of innocent blood.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'
native_verses.27:26: 'Cursed is the one who does not uphold the words of this law by doing them.' And all the people shall say, 'Amen.'"
native_verses.28:1: And it will come about that if you truly listen to the voice of the LORD your God, taking care to carry out all His commands that I am commanding you today, the LORD your God will place you highest above all the nations of the earth.
native_verses.28:2: And all these blessings will come on you and catch up with you, if you listen to the voice of the LORD your God.
native_verses.28:3: You will be blessed in the city, and you will be blessed in the field.
native_verses.28:4: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, and the fruit of your soil, and the fruit of your livestock—the offspring of your cattle and the increase of your flock.
native_verses.28:5: Your basket and your kneading bowl will be blessed.
native_verses.28:6: You will be blessed in your coming in, and you will be blessed in your going out.
native_verses.28:7: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck down before you; by one way they will go out against you, and by seven ways they will flee before you.
native_verses.28:8: The LORD will command the blessing to be with you in your granaries and in every undertaking of your hand, and He will bless you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
native_verses.28:9: The LORD will establish you for Himself as a holy people, just as He swore to you, if you keep the commands of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.
native_verses.28:10: And all the peoples of the earth will see that the name of the LORD is called over you, and they will fear you.
native_verses.28:11: And the LORD will cause you to overflow with prosperity, in the fruit of your womb, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your soil, upon the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
native_verses.28:12: The LORD will open for you His good treasury, the heavens, to give the rain of your land at its time and to bless every work of your hand; and you will lend to many nations, while you yourself will not borrow.
native_verses.28:13: And the LORD will set you as the head and not the tail, and you will be only above and will not be below, if you listen to the commands of the LORD your God that I am commanding you today, to keep and to carry out,
native_verses.28:14: and you do not turn aside from any of the words that I am commanding you today, to the right or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
native_verses.28:15: But it will come about that if you do not listen to the voice of the LORD your God, taking care to carry out all His commands and His statutes that I am commanding you today, then all these curses will come on you and catch up with you.
native_verses.28:16: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.
native_verses.28:17: Your basket and your kneading bowl will be cursed.
native_verses.28:18: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, and the fruit of your soil, the offspring of your cattle, and the increase of your flock.
native_verses.28:19: You will be cursed in your coming in, and you will be cursed in your going out.
native_verses.28:20: The LORD will send against you curse, panic, and rebuke in every undertaking of your hand that you do, until you are destroyed and until you perish swiftly, because of the wickedness of your deeds, in that you have forsaken Me.
native_verses.28:21: The LORD will cause pestilence to cling to you until He wipes you out from the land that you are entering to possess.
native_verses.28:22: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever, with inflammation, with scorching heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew, and they will pursue you until you perish.
native_verses.28:23: And your heavens that are above your head will be bronze, and the earth that is beneath you will be iron.
native_verses.28:24: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into fine dust and earth; from the heavens it will come down on you until you are destroyed.
native_verses.28:25: The LORD will cause you to be struck down before your enemies; by one way you will go out against them, and by seven ways you will flee before them; and you will become an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
native_verses.28:26: And your corpse will become food for all the birds of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth, with no one to scare them away.
native_verses.28:27: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with hemorrhoids, with scabs, and with the itch, from which you will not be able to be healed.
native_verses.28:28: The LORD will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with confusion of heart.
native_verses.28:29: And you will be groping at midday, just as a blind man gropes in thick darkness, and you will not make your ways succeed; and you will be only oppressed and robbed all the time, with no rescuer.
